j.id: 1652211", "j.title: Agronom, Forslundagymnasiet
j.description: Forslunda high school is located in a beautiful rural environment only 5 km from the center of Umeå. The high school has about 130 students, an adapted high school about 30 students and adult education in gardening, land and construction with about 80 students. The school runs its own modern farm, with around 60 dairy cows, calves and a herd of sheep. There are 170 ha of arable land for crop cultivation, where everything today is produced organically. The milk that Forslunda delivers to Norrmejerier is organic. The school also has a horse stable, dog training hall and an animal house with around 100 different species of small animals. There is also a student dormitory at the school. Your dutiesTeaching in crop cultivation, soil and plant biology. You carry out planning together with the operations manager in the plant cultivation at Forslunda as well as other tasks within agriculture and natural farming high school. You belong to a work team together with other teachers who are responsible for the education of our students. Together with your colleagues, you are responsible for running and developing the educational work based on the curriculum and the goals of the business, as well as in collaboration with other staff in the business. We would like for you to have teaching training with competence in farm animals and experience of teaching students or other leadership roles within, for example, association life. You have great collaboration skills and are solution-focused. You have the ability to find yourself in many different contexts, you see opportunities and like when a lot is happening around you. We are looking for you who want to support and motivate our students both in their knowledge and personal development. You are a person who creates good relationships and feels confident teaching students. You are a team player who prioritizes dialogue and is thorough and structured in your way of working. The position requires a valid extract from the employment register. For this position, a B driver's license is required. the region's largest employer with over 13,000 employees. The municipality has approximately 440 managers and the operations are divided into eight administrations. Our jobs and our core values ​​are based on citizen focus, openness, trust and continuous improvement. Umeå is a cultural city in constant development. In order to meet the goal of 200,000 inhabitants in 2050, we need more people working for growth and welfare. We know that differences enrich and welcome everyone to apply for a job with us. In the next ten years, we will hire around a thousand employees every year. Do you want to become one of us? Here you can find out what it's like to live and live in Umeå: https://www.umea.se/flyttaUmeå municipality is part of three administrative areas for Finnish, Meänkieli and Sami www.umea.se /minorities. As an employee with us in Umeå municipality, you can take advantage of a number of benefits. Take advantage of our benefits https://umea.se/jobbochforetagande/jobbochpraktik/kommunensomarbetsgivare/varaformaner.4.1b4d24fb1752122eb843bf.html Do you sell advertisements or offer recruitment support? Please do not contact us about it! We select and contact the companies we collaborate with ourselves.
j.id: 1807209", "j.title: Business manager for the new center for sustainable primary production
j.description: The unit for cooperation and development Do you want to take a key role in the development of knowledge for a sustainable primary production of food? Through an investment in the future, in collaboration between Sparbanken Skåne and SLU, this knowledge center is now being established, which will take advantage of Skåne's excellent conditions for sustainable food production through knowledge, innovation and new technical opportunities in collaboration between academia and the agricultural and horticultural industries. We are now looking for you to lead the center's development from the start, in close collaboration with SLU's research and education and with the support of management functions. You will be the operative spider in the network to take advantage of synergies and secure progress in the business. Read more in SLU's press release: 50 million invested in new knowledge center for sustainable food production in Alnarp | Externwebben (slu.se) About the job SLU and Sparbanken Skåne's center for sustainable primary production The formation of the center will promote sustainable primary production and work for a robust food chain that benefits economic growth and development in Scania in the long term. Through outstanding research and education, the center will collaborate with business and public actors to develop, disseminate and utilize knowledge and new solutions for a transition that balances economic, ecological and social sustainability. The center has four overarching goal areas for the operation.• Increased knowledge and innovation for increased sustainability in primary production• Increased collaboration in research and development• Higher level of technology in research, education and industry• Strengthen Skåne's contribution to the development of primary production in Sweden The center shall contribute to creating collaborations in order to make use of competence and resources which, in the long run, lead to even more results in primary production companies and in research and education. Duties Your area of ​​responsibility as business manager is to, in dialogue with management functions, be responsible for the centre's whole and sub-projects and to be the contact person towards Sparbanken Skåne and other partners to ensure business progress and goal achievement. A particular focus is to • develop the center with support from the steering group and advisory board • ensure the center's progress in line with the operational plan where coordination of sub-activities and utilization of synergies within the center and with other activities is included as a significant part • represent the center in contacts within and outside SLU • work to ensure that the business can be strengthened by, for example, taking initiatives for collaborations with relevant actors and research applications for supplementary funding• work actively for the business's contribution to making a difference for primary producers in Skåne• work for the center's mutual benefit for academia and practice Your manager is the head of unit at the unit for collaboration and development. Your background As an applicant for the position, you must have an academic degree in subject areas relevant to the future development of primary production and related areas. You must have experience of having coordinated collaborations in a leading position and also have worked in or in contact with academic environments. You must have documented leadership experience with financial responsibility. You must be responsive and goal-oriented with an inclusive, communicative and process-oriented way of working. Furthermore, you must be a driven person who is used to working independently while participating in teamwork. Good ability to express oneself verbally and in writing in Swedish and English is a requirement. As networking is an important part of the work, a driver's license is a requirement.  For us, personal suitability is crucial. About us LTV Faculty - Landscape Architecture, Horticulture and Plant Production Science The center has its organizational home at the LTV Faculty. World-leading research in landscape architecture, horticultural science and plant production is conducted here. The faculty offers several educational programs, including the agriculturist program, the horticultural engineering program, and the agroecology program. The LTV faculty is mostly located in Alnarp, in the middle of Sweden's most dynamic agricultural, horticultural and food region. The position will have its operational residence at the unit for collaboration and development in Alnarp. The unit is a cooperation-supporting resource with the task of developing and supporting SLU's internal and external cooperation in order to strengthen the quality and social relevance of SLU's research, education and environmental analysis. Since the cooperation should lead to mutual benefit, the activity should also contribute to knowledge-driven development of companies and relevant organizations in society. At SLU, you take your walk-and-talk meetings and lunchtime walks in the unique Alnarpsparken. Watch the film about our campus at https://www.slu.se/alnarpsfilmen Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Location: Alnarp Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU applies 6 month trial employment Scope: 100% or according to agreement Access: According to agreement Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2024-10-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/ The Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

In daily work, you are a present manager who practices a trust -based leadership to create a good workplace for your employees and colleagues. You have target and results responsibility for the function and work closely with the unit manager and deputy unit manager on issues related to financial follow-up and strategic planning. You are part of the unit's management team and together with other managers take overall responsibility for the unit's operations and development. Collaborations with other function managers on the county administrative board and in cross -sectoral working groups are a natural part of your work. In addition to your managerial assignment you will also work with other tasks that are included in the operation of the function or unit. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. You communicate and handle any conflicts in a constructive way, are loyal to your mission and have a positive attitude towards your work.  You can weigh complex information and show judgment in statements, actions and decisions. The work requires that you are structured and can plan, organize and prioritize in an appropriate way, you set up and keep time frames for your work. In order to succeed in the role, it is important to be able to collaborate with both people on the unit and other units and to be able to see whole and take into account a larger perspective. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference for our county and society. The County Administrative Board is a broad authority, which means that you are constantly being given the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a great focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health promotion wellness activities. We care about collaboration with our trade union parties and can offer distance work. Depending on service, it may include service in crisis staff and security rating. We usually start with probationary employment at permanent services.information on how we process your personal data can be found at www.lansstyrelsen.se/datasktkt
j.id: 1870403", "j.title: Driftmaskinist
j.description: Are you a versatile and solution-oriented person who is looking for a new exciting assignment? Do you enjoy a technical and varied role where you get to be part of the development towards a more sustainable future? Then we would have been a good match. Now we are looking for you who want to become our new Drift Machinist at Hässleholms Circuit Center (HKC). Hässleholms Kretsloppscenter is an active player that works clearly and closely with its customers in the market. For several years, we have invested in increased production resources and efficient and modern treatment technology. In the land remediation segment, HKC is a strong partner with great resources. In recent years, the facility has handled large amounts of contaminated mass from projects in the southern parts of the country. Our customers appreciate that we have large resources, high knowledge and a strong customer focus. Duties As an operating machinist at Hässleholm Circuit Center in Vankiva, you will have varied and exciting work where you will have great opportunities to influence your work and your own development. You will be part of the Process and Maintenance unit. Together with your colleagues, you work for a safe and optimized operation of our technical facilities, which includes: process control maintenance work, e.g. (property and road maintenance) operation of oil and treatment plants, treatment plants, gas plants and pump stations sampling and monitoring machine operation We are constantly working to develop and improve our processes, of which we are looking for a colleague who wants to be involved in the development of our business - working in projects together with colleagues but also independently driving improvements is a matter of course for us. Once you've warmed up in your clothes, preparedness will be part of your work. Who are you? To be successful in the role of operating machinist with us at Hässleholm Miljö AB, we see that you have a few years of experience in water treatment and/or operation & maintenance of process plants. In terms of education, you have a KY/YH education in process technology or equivalent education in the baggage. You have good computer skills and have worked in some control and regulation program. Most likely, you also have experience with chemical handling and work in an explosive environment. A B driver's license is a requirement for the position, and if you also have a wheel loader license and a forklift license, it is meritorious. Spoken and written English and Danish are also meritorious, while good spoken and written Swedish is a requirement for this position. Otherwise, we believe that you would describe yourself as a self-motivated person interested in technology. It is in your nature to be a curious problem solver and you are stimulated by being given and taking responsibility as well as independently driving and planning your work forward. Relationship building and collaboration are words you often use to describe your way of working. Other training required for the job, e.g. flammable explosives, gas supervisors, hot work and sampling you get when you're on site. Other The position is a permanent employment of 100% with immediate effect Start. The position begins with a 6-month probationary period. Note that selection will take place on a rolling basis, so you should apply for the position as soon as possible. At Hässleholm Miljö, we like different things! We strive for diversity in every conceivable way and value what mixed groups bring to the business. Do you want to know more about us as a company? Feel free to check out our social media! Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn - #viärhmabHässleholm Miljö is a business-driven company owned by Hässleholm municipality. Our mission is to develop and provide services within the environment and energy. We are a community partner that drives the development of what is really important, a sustainable circular society for people and businesses in our municipality. We do it with commitment and knowledge for a sustainable life today - and the courage to find new ways for tomorrow. Our operations are divided into four strong business areas, with common functions and processes. We collect, treat and recycle waste from households and industries and other activities. We produce and distribute drinking water, transport and purify waste water and divert storm water. In addition, we produce and deliver district heating in Hässleholm and Tyringe. But we also work with sustainability in everything we do, and to reduce our and others' impact on nature and the water around us. We have around 180 employees and our company has a turnover of around SEK 430 million every year. Read more about us at www. hassleholm environment. see.

j.id: 1689744", 'j.title: Försökstekniker
j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.
j.id: 1787132', "j.title: Gardener to Crafttech in northern Stockholm
j.description: Crafttech is a company consisting of garden enthusiasts and is engaged in gardening, mainly in the northern Stockholm area. Now we are looking for a knowledgeable and committed gardener/gardener for our business in Vallentuna. If Ossvi offers fun and varied work in a pleasant company. With us you get the opportunity to develop and learn new skills. We are a relatively small working group with a common interest in gardening. We strive for harmony and joy in the working group and with us it is obvious that everyone helps each other. This is also why we have so much fun together. As a gardener you are responsible for the maintenance and maintenance of gardens and green areas. Your tasks include mowing, edge trimming, pruning of trees and shrubs and planting and weed cleaning. You ensure that the soil gets the right nutrition, takes care of irrigation and keeps areas clean by removing leaves and garden waste. For the health of lawns, you perform aeration, vertical cutting and moss control. You also make sure that aisles and patios are kept stylish and free of dirt. We are looking for you who have experience of or a great interest in gardening. You are responsible, organized and have an eye for details. The work is done outdoors all year round, and we are looking for someone who enjoys a physical work and who is ready to take on different tasks with great commitment. It is a merit if you have an education in gardening or a related area. If you lack formal education, we value drive, responsiveness and a desire to learn instead. You should have a high work ethic, be able to work independently and at the same time be a team player who cooperates well with colleagues.B driving license and good knowledge of Swedish, both in speech and writing, is a requirement. If you have a driver's license for wheel loaders, experience in tree pruning or good plant knowledge, we also see it as a merit. Terms for the service: start date: by agreement, but preferably as soon as possible. Employment form and scope: The service is a full -time permanent position (probationary employment). Working hours during the summer (April-Oct): Mon-Tor 06.30-16.00 and Fri 06.30-12.30 Working hours during the winter season (Nov-Mars): Mon-Fri 07: 00-16: 00VI offers market salaries and secure terms of employment through collective agreements for all our services. Do not hesitate to apply today! We conduct selection and interviews on an ongoing basis, so appointment can be made before the last application date. We do not accept applications by e -mail, but if you have any questions about the service, you are welcome to contact richard.bergstrom@crafttech.se.crafttech is part of Verdis - a leading player in the environmental industry who works with collection and transport of waste. Our ambition is to always deliver sustainable solutions and contribute to a greener society. With our services we reach about 1.5 million people in some thirty municipalities in Sweden. Our employees play a crucial role in our success - every day they contribute their commitment, their knowledge and their strong drive to create sustainable improvements. With us, the work culture is characterized by collaboration, innovation and a common pursuit of a greener future. Do you want to become part of our team and contribute to sustainable development? Welcome with your application!
j.id: 1958636", "j.title: Kundansvarig till Biototal med arbetsområde Gävle med omnejd
j.description: CUSTOMER RESPONSIBLE FOR BIOTOTAL WITH WORK AREA GÄVLE WITH SURROUNDINGSAbout the Biototal Group: Within the Biototal Group we work for sustainable solutions between city and country with the goal of utilizing all resources so they are useful in the cycle. Through our work, we see a clear improvement when it comes to increased fertility. Our vision is to contribute to a better environment, develop long-term sustainable solutions and at the same time create financial value for the parties involved. We are expanding and are therefore looking for another colleague located in Gävle and the surrounding area. About the role: In the role of Customer Manager, you will be an intermediary to our customers such as farmers, treatment plants, industries and biogas plants. You run your work and dialogue with customers independently, while you have a committed and knowledgeable team behind you. Among other things, you will be responsible for the sale and mediation of residual products for recycling. You will also develop relationships with authorities, contractors and carriers. The work involves an exciting and varied everyday life where you will work both out in the field and from the office in Uppsala. Your work area is Gästrikland, Dalarna and Norra Uppland, which means that travel is part of the work. Sometimes with an overnight stay. B driver's license is a requirement and a company car is provided. The position is a permanent position with a start according to agreement. A trial employment may be applied at the start of the employment. Your profile: We are looking for a relationship builder with great interest and knowledge in agriculture. If you have previous experience of building long-term customer relationships in an advisory or sales role towards farmers, that is a big advantage. We would like you to have knowledge in agronomy and a basic understanding of the processes in plant nutrition. Practical experience from agriculture is highly meritorious for the role. Most likely, you have a university education as an agronomist, farm manager, farm manager or agrotechnician, alternatively you have acquired the corresponding practical knowledge in crop cultivation in another way. You are good at communicating both verbally and in writing and building relationships with customers. Furthermore, you thrive in a role where you are both given the opportunity to work in the field and with planning and documentation. As a person, you have a positive attitude, are flexible and have the ability to take your own initiative and drive your work forward. You are also used to handling the Office package and digital tools. Our offer: We offer you a free job where you can work independently, with great opportunity to influence the path towards the goal. You get a bunch of nice and curious colleagues who are passionate about creating long-term sustainable solutions in the green industry together. We offer you exciting work in a company where we always support each other in finding sustainable and long-term business plans. We care about well-being and cooperation throughout the organization. Application: We are collaborating with Paragera in this recruitment. Submit your application in the form of a CV and personal letter via the form below no later than 8/12 - 2024. If you have questions about the position, please contact our Recruitment Consultant, Annelie Haevaker, via e-mail at annelie.haevaker@paragera.se

j.id: 1831136", "j.title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
j.description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Naturbruksförvaltningen is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to apply to. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. Description With us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, non-prestige and have a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machinery and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out into agriculture to learn the craft to become the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent skills Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license motor- clearing chainsawExperience of digitization in agriculture such as auto control, etc. We place great emphasis on personal suitability. Conditions The employment is a temporary position during the period February-November 2025 which may be extended with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! About the Västra Götaland region The Västra Götaland region exists for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure that there is good healthcare for everyone. We work for sustainable development and growth, a good environment, improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland. The Västra Götaland region works actively to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you have basic skills and can use digital tools and services. You can search for information, communicate, interact digitally, are risk-aware and have motivation to participate in development in order to learn new things. The Västra Götaland region hires all permanent employees. If you want to know more about the Västra Götaland region, you can visit our introduction to new employees at the link https: //www.vgregion.se/introduktion.  You can also read more in the presentation about https://mellanarkiv-offentlig.vgregion.se/alfresco/s/archive/stream/public/v1/source/available/sofia/rs4011-467070786-672/surrogate.ApplicationVästra Götalandregionen prefers that you register your application via the recruitment system. If you, as an applicant, have questions about the advertised position or for special and special reasons cannot register your data in a public system - contact the contact person for the respective advertisement. To staffing, brokerage and recruitment companies and to you who are sellers: We refrain from friendly but firm direct contact with staffing, brokerage and recruitment companies as well as other external actors and sellers of additional job advertisements. The Västra Götaland region has procured agreements.

j.id: 1647466", "j.title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
j.description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Natural Resources Administration is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here, we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to search for. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. DescriptionWith us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, lack of prestige and a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the work team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machines and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out in agriculture to learn the craft of becoming the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent knowledge Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license engine clearing chainsaw Experience of digitization in agriculture such as auto steering etc. We attach great importance to personal suitability. j.id: 1703236", "j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. j.id: 1652211", "j.title: Agronom, Forslundagymnasiet
j.description: Forslunda high school is located in a beautiful rural environment only 5 km from the center of Umeå. The high school has about 130 students, an adapted high school about 30 students and adult education in gardening, land and construction with about 80 students. The school runs its own modern farm, with around 60 dairy cows, calves and a herd of sheep. There are 170 ha of arable land for crop cultivation, where everything today is produced organically. The milk that Forslunda delivers to Norrmejerier is organic. The school also has a horse stable, dog training hall and an animal house with around 100 different species of small animals. There is also a student dormitory at the school. Your dutiesTeaching in crop cultivation, soil and plant biology. You carry out planning together with the operations manager in the plant cultivation at Forslunda as well as other tasks within agriculture and natural farming high school. You belong to a work team together with other teachers who are responsible for the education of our students. Together with your colleagues, you are responsible for running and developing the educational work based on the curriculum and the goals of the business, as well as in collaboration with other staff in the business. We would like for you to have teaching training with competence in farm animals and experience of teaching students or other leadership roles within, for example, association life. You have great collaboration skills and are solution-focused. You have the ability to find yourself in many different contexts, you see opportunities and like when a lot is happening around you. We are looking for you who want to support and motivate our students both in their knowledge and personal development. You are a person who creates good relationships and feels confident teaching students. You are a team player who prioritizes dialogue and is thorough and structured in your way of working. The position requires a valid extract from the employment register. For this position, a B driver's license is required. the region's largest employer with over 13,000 employees. The municipality has approximately 440 managers and the operations are divided into eight administrations. Our jobs and our core values ​​are based on citizen focus, openness, trust and continuous improvement. Umeå is a cultural city in constant development. In order to meet the goal of 200,000 inhabitants in 2050, we need more people working for growth and welfare. We know that differences enrich and welcome everyone to apply for a job with us. In the next ten years, we will hire around a thousand employees every year. Do you want to become one of us? Here you can find out what it's like to live and live in Umeå: https://www.umea.se/flyttaUmeå municipality is part of three administrative areas for Finnish, Meänkieli and Sami www.umea.se /minorities. As an employee with us in Umeå municipality, you can take advantage of a number of benefits. Take advantage of our benefits https://umea.se/jobbochforetagande/jobbochpraktik/kommunensomarbetsgivare/varaformaner.4.1b4d24fb1752122eb843bf.html Do you sell advertisements or offer recruitment support? Please do not contact us about it! We select and contact the companies we collaborate with ourselves.
j.id: 1807209", "j.title: Business manager for the new center for sustainable primary production
j.description: The unit for cooperation and development Do you want to take a key role in the development of knowledge for a sustainable primary production of food? Through an investment in the future, in collaboration between Sparbanken Skåne and SLU, this knowledge center is now being established, which will take advantage of Skåne's excellent conditions for sustainable food production through knowledge, innovation and new technical opportunities in collaboration between academia and the agricultural and horticultural industries. We are now looking for you to lead the center's development from the start, in close collaboration with SLU's research and education and with the support of management functions. You will be the operative spider in the network to take advantage of synergies and secure progress in the business. Read more in SLU's press release: 50 million invested in new knowledge center for sustainable food production in Alnarp | Externwebben (slu.se) About the job SLU and Sparbanken Skåne's center for sustainable primary production The formation of the center will promote sustainable primary production and work for a robust food chain that benefits economic growth and development in Scania in the long term. Through outstanding research and education, the center will collaborate with business and public actors to develop, disseminate and utilize knowledge and new solutions for a transition that balances economic, ecological and social sustainability. The center has four overarching goal areas for the operation.• Increased knowledge and innovation for increased sustainability in primary production• Increased collaboration in research and development• Higher level of technology in research, education and industry• Strengthen Skåne's contribution to the development of primary production in Sweden The center shall contribute to creating collaborations in order to make use of competence and resources which, in the long run, lead to even more results in primary production companies and in research and education. Duties Your area of ​​responsibility as business manager is to, in dialogue with management functions, be responsible for the centre's whole and sub-projects and to be the contact person towards Sparbanken Skåne and other partners to ensure business progress and goal achievement. A particular focus is to • develop the center with support from the steering group and advisory board • ensure the center's progress in line with the operational plan where coordination of sub-activities and utilization of synergies within the center and with other activities is included as a significant part • represent the center in contacts within and outside SLU • work to ensure that the business can be strengthened by, for example, taking initiatives for collaborations with relevant actors and research applications for supplementary funding• work actively for the business's contribution to making a difference for primary producers in Skåne• work for the center's mutual benefit for academia and practice Your manager is the head of unit at the unit for collaboration and development. Your background As an applicant for the position, you must have an academic degree in subject areas relevant to the future development of primary production and related areas. You must have experience of having coordinated collaborations in a leading position and also have worked in or in contact with academic environments. You must have documented leadership experience with financial responsibility. You must be responsive and goal-oriented with an inclusive, communicative and process-oriented way of working. Furthermore, you must be a driven person who is used to working independently while participating in teamwork. Good ability to express oneself verbally and in writing in Swedish and English is a requirement. As networking is an important part of the work, a driver's license is a requirement.  For us, personal suitability is crucial. About us LTV Faculty - Landscape Architecture, Horticulture and Plant Production Science The center has its organizational home at the LTV Faculty. World-leading research in landscape architecture, horticultural science and plant production is conducted here. The faculty offers several educational programs, including the agriculturist program, the horticultural engineering program, and the agroecology program. The LTV faculty is mostly located in Alnarp, in the middle of Sweden's most dynamic agricultural, horticultural and food region. The position will have its operational residence at the unit for collaboration and development in Alnarp. The unit is a cooperation-supporting resource with the task of developing and supporting SLU's internal and external cooperation in order to strengthen the quality and social relevance of SLU's research, education and environmental analysis. Since the cooperation should lead to mutual benefit, the activity should also contribute to knowledge-driven development of companies and relevant organizations in society. At SLU, you take your walk-and-talk meetings and lunchtime walks in the unique Alnarpsparken. Watch the film about our campus at https://www.slu.se/alnarpsfilmen Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Location: Alnarp Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU applies 6 month trial employment Scope: 100% or according to agreement Access: According to agreement Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2024-10-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/ The Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

We are now looking for you to lead the center's development from the start, in close collaboration with SLU's research and education and with the support of management functions. You will be the operative spider in the network to take advantage of synergies and secure progress in the business. Read more in SLU's press release: 50 million invested in new knowledge center for sustainable food production in Alnarp | Externwebben (slu.se) About the job SLU and Sparbanken Skåne's center for sustainable primary production The formation of the center will promote sustainable primary production and work for a robust food chain that benefits economic growth and development in Scania in the long term. Through outstanding research and education, the center will collaborate with business and public actors to develop, disseminate and utilize knowledge and new solutions for a transition that balances economic, ecological and social sustainability. The center has four overarching goal areas for the operation.• Increased knowledge and innovation for increased sustainability in primary production• Increased collaboration in research and development• Higher level of technology in research, education and industry• Strengthen Skåne's contribution to the development of primary production in Sweden The center shall contribute to creating collaborations in order to make use of competence and resources which, in the long run, lead to even more results in primary production companies and in research and education. Duties Your area of ​​responsibility as business manager is to, in dialogue with management functions, be responsible for the centre's whole and sub-projects and to be the contact person towards Sparbanken Skåne and other partners to ensure business progress and goal achievement. A particular focus is to • develop the center with support from the steering group and advisory board • ensure the center's progress in line with the operational plan where coordination of sub-activities and utilization of synergies within the center and with other activities is included as a significant part • represent the center in contacts within and outside SLU • work to ensure that the business can be strengthened by, for example, taking initiatives for collaborations with relevant actors and research applications for supplementary funding• work actively for the business's contribution to making a difference for primary producers in Skåne• work for the center's mutual benefit for academia and practice Your manager is the head of unit at the unit for collaboration and development. Your background As an applicant for the position, you must have an academic degree in subject areas relevant to the future development of primary production and related areas. You must have experience of having coordinated collaborations in a leading position and also have worked in or in contact with academic environments. You must have documented leadership experience with financial responsibility. You must be responsive and goal-oriented with an inclusive, communicative and process-oriented way of working. Furthermore, you must be a driven person who is used to working independently while participating in teamwork. Good ability to express oneself verbally and in writing in Swedish and English is a requirement. As networking is an important part of the work, a driver's license is a requirement.  For us, personal suitability is crucial. About us LTV Faculty - Landscape Architecture, Horticulture and Plant Production Science The center has its organizational home at the LTV Faculty. World-leading research in landscape architecture, horticultural science and plant production is conducted here. The faculty offers several educational programs, including the agriculturist program, the horticultural engineering program, and the agroecology program. The LTV faculty is mostly located in Alnarp, in the middle of Sweden's most dynamic agricultural, horticultural and food region. The position will have its operational residence at the unit for collaboration and development in Alnarp. The unit is a cooperation-supporting resource with the task of developing and supporting SLU's internal and external cooperation in order to strengthen the quality and social relevance of SLU's research, education and environmental analysis. Since the cooperation should lead to mutual benefit, the activity should also contribute to knowledge-driven development of companies and relevant organizations in society. At SLU, you take your walk-and-talk meetings and lunchtime walks in the unique Alnarpsparken. Watch the film about our campus at https://www.slu.se/alnarpsfilmen Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Location: Alnarp Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU applies 6 month trial employment Scope: 100% or according to agreement Access: According to agreement Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2024-10-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/ The Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.description: The County Administrative Board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to safeguard the qualities that diversity adds the business. The country countryside unit is one of the County Administrative Board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic payment services. Within the unit there is also Interreg Sweden the Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sectoral cooperation on the county administrative board. With us, experts work in these areas who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness to the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! Descriptions The newly formed function of agricultural support we are now looking for a manager. The function consists of between 10 -15 Employees depending on the season and work mainly with handling and control of animal and area-based support for agriculture, register checks on animals and land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties. The function also participates in cross -sectoral collaborations on the county administrative board and acts as experts when answering referrals and when preparing various issues linked to the county's agriculture. Work tasks as a function manager will be your role to lead the work based on our assignment and in accordance with the county administrative board's overall priorities. In daily work, you are a present manager who practices a trust -based leadership to create a good workplace for your employees and colleagues. You have target and results responsibility for the function and work closely with the unit manager and deputy unit manager on issues related to financial follow-up and strategic planning. You are part of the unit's management team and together with other managers take overall responsibility for the unit's operations and development. Collaborations with other function managers on the county administrative board and in cross -sectoral working groups are a natural part of your work. In addition to your managerial assignment you will also work with other tasks that are included in the operation of the function or unit. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. You communicate and handle any conflicts in a constructive way, are loyal to your mission and have a positive attitude towards your work.  You can weigh complex information and show judgment in statements, actions and decisions. The work requires that you are structured and can plan, organize and prioritize in an appropriate way, you set up and keep time frames for your work. In order to succeed in the role, it is important to be able to collaborate with both people on the unit and other units and to be able to see whole and take into account a larger perspective. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference for our county and society. The County Administrative Board is a broad authority, which means that you are constantly being given the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a great focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health promotion wellness activities. We care about collaboration with our trade union parties and can offer distance work. Depending on service, it may include service in crisis staff and security rating. We usually start with probationary employment at permanent services.information on how we process your personal data can be found at www.lansstyrelsen.se/datasktkt

j.description: Are you a versatile and solution-oriented person who is looking for a new exciting assignment? Do you enjoy a technical and varied role where you get to be part of the development towards a more sustainable future? Then we would have been a good match. Now we are looking for you who want to become our new Drift Machinist at Hässleholms Circuit Center (HKC). Hässleholms Kretsloppscenter is an active player that works clearly and closely with its customers in the market. For several years, we have invested in increased production resources and efficient and modern treatment technology. In the land remediation segment, HKC is a strong partner with great resources. In recent years, the facility has handled large amounts of contaminated mass from projects in the southern parts of the country. Our customers appreciate that we have large resources, high knowledge and a strong customer focus. Duties As an operating machinist at Hässleholm Circuit Center in Vankiva, you will have varied and exciting work where you will have great opportunities to influence your work and your own development. You will be part of the Process and Maintenance unit. Together with your colleagues, you work for a safe and optimized operation of our technical facilities, which includes: process control maintenance work, e.g. (property and road maintenance) operation of oil and treatment plants, treatment plants, gas plants and pump stations sampling and monitoring machine operation We are constantly working to develop and improve our processes, of which we are looking for a colleague who wants to be involved in the development of our business - working in projects together with colleagues but also independently driving improvements is a matter of course for us. Once you've warmed up in your clothes, preparedness will be part of your work. Who are you? To be successful in the role of operating machinist with us at Hässleholm Miljö AB, we see that you have a few years of experience in water treatment and/or operation & maintenance of process plants. In terms of education, you have a KY/YH education in process technology or equivalent education in the baggage. You have good computer skills and have worked in some control and regulation program. Most likely, you also have experience with chemical handling and work in an explosive environment. A B driver's license is a requirement for the position, and if you also have a wheel loader license and a forklift license, it is meritorious. Spoken and written English and Danish are also meritorious, while good spoken and written Swedish is a requirement for this position. Otherwise, we believe that you would describe yourself as a self-motivated person interested in technology. It is in your nature to be a curious problem solver and you are stimulated by being given and taking responsibility as well as independently driving and planning your work forward. Relationship building and collaboration are words you often use to describe your way of working. Other training required for the job, e.g. flammable explosives, gas supervisors, hot work and sampling you get when you're on site. Other The position is a permanent employment of 100% with immediate effect Start. The position begins with a 6-month probationary period. Note that selection will take place on a rolling basis, so you should apply for the position as soon as possible. At Hässleholm Miljö, we like different things! We strive for diversity in every conceivable way and value what mixed groups bring to the business. Do you want to know more about us as a company? Feel free to check out our social media! Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn - #viärhmabHässleholm Miljö is a business-driven company owned by Hässleholm municipality. Our mission is to develop and provide services within the environment and energy. We are a community partner that drives the development of what is really important, a sustainable circular society for people and businesses in our municipality. We do it with commitment and knowledge for a sustainable life today - and the courage to find new ways for tomorrow. Our operations are divided into four strong business areas, with common functions and processes. We collect, treat and recycle waste from households and industries and other activities. We produce and distribute drinking water, transport and purify waste water and divert storm water. In addition, we produce and deliver district heating in Hässleholm and Tyringe. But we also work with sustainability in everything we do, and to reduce our and others' impact on nature and the water around us. We have around 180 employees and our company has a turnover of around SEK 430 million every year. Read more about us at www. hassleholm environment. see.
