j.title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
j.description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Naturbruksförvaltningen is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to apply to. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. Description With us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, non-prestige and have a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machinery and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out into agriculture to learn the craft to become the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent skills Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license motor- clearing chainsawExperience of digitization in agriculture such as auto control, etc. We place great emphasis on personal suitability. Conditions The employment is a temporary position during the period February-November 2025 which may be extended with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! About the Västra Götaland region The Västra Götaland region exists for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure that there is good healthcare for everyone. We work for sustainable development and growth, a good environment, improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland. The Västra Götaland region works actively to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you have basic skills and can use digital tools and services. You can search for information, communicate, interact digitally, are risk-aware and have motivation to participate in development in order to learn new things. The Västra Götaland region hires all permanent employees. If you want to know more about the Västra Götaland region, you can visit our introduction to new employees at the link https: //www.vgregion.se/introduktion. j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!', 'job_title: Sales manager north, Väktodling

description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!",

            "job_title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great.             "job_title: Traktorförare Säsong 2025
description: For Framtidsgården Bjertorp, we are now looking for you with a great interest in the agriculture of the future and who wants to work in an engaging and happy team with a fast pace during the season 2025. Bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruk's Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We run a modern and rational agriculture on 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens Egendom, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and the development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition to this, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The trial operation covers approximately 20 hectares and 6,000 trial plots which are distributed over the farm's area. The position is a seasonal position for the 2025 season, starting April 1 and running until October 31. There is the possibility of extension, and access is by agreement. This is what you will do. Together with other staff, you will primarily manage the operations to be carried out on a crop farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and fodder harvesting in Viken. You will also help with the sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loader driving and machine maintenance occurs. All work in the field is carried out with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest machine technology to ensure high efficiency, precision and durability. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have: An agricultural education (or several years of experience in the profession) Experience of driving machinery and a great interest in agriculture B driver's license Good knowledge of the Swedish language You are: Responsible and thorough in your work A team player who can cooperate with others in your environment, but who can also work independently Spraying certificate is a merit You shares our values ​​Openness, Holistic view and Action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you will have the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment takes place according to agreement, with a desirable start date from 1 April to 31 October. There is the possibility of an extension. The location of the position is Kvänum, where you will report to the operations manager. If necessary, housing is available. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28, 2025. Selection takes place continuously. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com. Contact PersonKjell Carlssonkjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com",
            "job_title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. job_title: Lantbruksarbete med fokus på växtodling och maskiner
description: Employees at a farm with a focus on crop cultivation. Speaking Swedish is a requirement. The farm is outside Stallarholmen in Södermanland. Klahammar grows cereals, oil plants and seeds on approx. 550 ha, as well as a small diko herd. The farm includes 9 residential buildings that are rented out and approx. 150 ha of forest. The machine park is modern and updated on an ongoing basis, and we use GPS and sensor technology. Most of the grain is dried and stored on the farm. We continuously develop and optimize the farm's production branches. Today, we are 2 people who work full time, with extra staff during the season. You are expected to be involved in all tasks occurring on the farm with a focus on crop cultivation during the growing season and animals, forest and maintenance in winter. We review applications on an ongoing basis and fill the position when we have found the right person. job_title: Maskinförare,Lantarbetare Öjeby Gård
description: We offer you a key role in an expansive agriculture and contracting company with about 60 employees, of which about 10 are in the yard. Your role as a machine driver/farm worker is a very important part of our future agriculture where you have the opportunity to develop further in your service. In the yard there are about 400 annuals and plant cultivation comprises just over 1000 hectares and we have an organic operation. We look forward to your application. Open for Allavi focuses on your skills, not your other conditions. We are open to adapt the role or workplace to your needs.

job_title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property
description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. More information about the institution/department: https://internal. sly see/Organisation-och-styrningen/organisation/gemensamma-verkehsamstodet/egendomsavdelningen/lantbruksdriften/Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www. sly se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Lanna research station, Saleby, Lidköping Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment. Scope: 100% Access: By agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 12/16/2024. Union contact persons: https://internal. sly see/my-anstalling/union/contacts/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and PhD students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

job_title: Regionchef
description: Do you want to be part of driving Lantmännen Lantbruk's plant growing business forward in northern Sweden? Do you have a great interest in agriculture? Then this is the role for you! We are now looking for a committed and driven Regional Manager for the northern region. Here you get the opportunity to be part of a successful team where we combine ambition and humility. In Lantmännen's group, agriculture is the heart and the core business that forms the basis of our entire broad business. With our unique value chain, we take responsibility from farm to table every day. This is what you will do As Regional Manager in the North, you are Lantmännen's face in the region, both to customers/members and other stakeholders. You lead a committed team of crop salesmen who are spread out in northern Sweden, from the coast to the inland. The crop sellers sell crop supplies and buy grain. Your main task is to develop the business together with colleagues in crop cultivation, grain purchasing and feed and ensure that we meet the needs of both customers and members. You work closely with product managers and product developers to continuously improve our offer with the customer's perspective in focus. You prepare and implement long-term sales plans and are responsible for your team reaching set goals and budgets, both in terms of volume and profitability.  You start from one of Lantmännen Lanbruk's sales offices in Mälardalen. The role involves travel within the region to work closely with both your team and our customers. You report to Lantmännen's crop production manager. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have a genuine interest in agriculture and business development. Post-secondary agricultural education or equivalent experience in the field. Experience in sales and working to a budget. Previous experience in leading and developing teams.  You are relationship-building and find it easy to build effective and positive collaborations. A clear leader who listens and adapts your leadership to the situation. Motivating and inspiring with the ability to make others succeed. Results-oriented, self-motivated and focused on achieving goals. Energetic and a positive force in meeting others.  You share our values: holistic view, openness and action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting role where you get the opportunity to both develop and be developed. At Lantmännen, you become part of a global group with a unique value chain and exciting career opportunities. We also have a strong focus on diversity and inclusion - here everyone should feel welcome and included. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 2nd. In your application, you have the option to add your CV or LinkedIn profile. For a more objective and inclusive recruitment process, we do not accept personal letters, but instead ask you to answer selection questions that are relevant to the position. The recruitment process includes both psychometric tests and competency-based interviews, with the aim of promoting a fair evaluation for all candidates. At Lantmännen, it is important that everyone has equal opportunities for employment and development in the group. As a final candidate, a background check will be carried out via our supplier ToFindOut. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are most welcome to contact Talent Acquisition Specialist, Matilda Olbin at matilda.olbin@lantmannen.com. We look forward to your application!Contact personMatilda Olbinmatilda.olbin@lantmannen.com

job_title: Sales manager north, Väktodling
description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

job_title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. job_title: Tractor and machine operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. Entry date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look today but no later than 15 March 2025. Salary according to increase. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

job_title: Traktorförare Säsong 2025
description: For Framtidsgården Bjertorp, we are now looking for you with a great interest in the agriculture of the future and who wants to work in an engaging and happy team with a fast pace during the season 2025. Bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruk's Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We run a modern and rational agriculture on 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens Egendom, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and the development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition to this, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The trial operation covers approximately 20 hectares and 6,000 trial plots which are distributed over the farm's area. The position is a seasonal position for the 2025 season, starting April 1 and running until October 31. There is the possibility of extension, and access is by agreement. This is what you will do. Together with other staff, you will primarily manage the operations to be carried out on a crop farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and fodder harvesting in Viken. You will also help with the sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loader driving and machine maintenance occurs. All work in the field is carried out with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest machine technology to ensure high efficiency, precision and durability. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have: An agricultural education (or several years of experience in the profession) Experience of driving machinery and a great interest in agriculture B driver's license Good knowledge of the Swedish language You are: Responsible and thorough in your work A team player who can cooperate with others in your environment, but who can also work independently Spraying certificate is a merit You shares our values ​​Openness, Holistic view and Action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you will have the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment takes place according to agreement, with a desirable start date from 1 April to 31 October. There is the possibility of an extension. The location of the position is Kvänum, where you will report to the operations manager. If necessary, housing is available. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28, 2025. Selection takes place continuously. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com. Contact PersonKjell Carlssonkjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com

job_title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

turns.content: Could you list all five occupations associated with this agricultural management skill?

Based on the database records provided, here are the five occupations associated with the skill related to the query:

1.  **Agronomist**: They provide consulting services on the cultivation of food crops, examine crops, perform experiments to improve yields, and examine the most effective ways to harvest and cultivate plants.
2.  **Livestock worker**: They maintain the health and welfare of animals and oversee breeding, production, and day-to-day care such as feeding and watering.
3.  **Agronomic crop production team leader**: They are responsible for leading a team of crop production workers, organizing daily work schedules, and participating in the production process.
4.  **Farm manager**: They plan and organize the daily operations, resourcing, and business management of animal and crop-producing farms.
5.  **Agricultural technician**: They collect and conduct experiments and tests on agriculture and aquaculture specimens, provide support to scientists and farmers, and analyze and report on environmental conditions.

j.description: Description of the entityThe Department of Agriculture and Marine Resources (DARM) is responsible for supporting, implementing, leading, monitoring and adapting regional and European policies in the agricultural sector and forestry, the equine economy, fishing and aquaculture as well as the valorization of land and sea products. It includes 103 agents and is organized into 5 services, a sectoral steering mission European funds FEADER (European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development) / FEAMPA (European Fund for Maritime Affairs, Fisheries and Aquaculture) and an internal control unit.  The challenges for management are: Supporting Norman farmers in the development of their farms and transitions; Better valorize regional forest production; Give new impetus to Normandy fishing and move towards recognized and diversified Normandy aquaculture; Promote agricultural, fishing and aquaculture products; Support professionals in the equine industry and promote this sector of excellence internationally.   Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. In this context, the challenge for the community is therefore to support young people wishing to settle in Normandy with the aim of ensuring the maintenance of the number of agricultural and equine businesses in its territory and allowing generational renewal. As part of its new 2023-2027 program, the Region has set itself the objective of creating 450 installations per year in Normandy.  The purpose of this position is to provide local supervision to a team of managers responsible for examining installation assistance files and overseeing regional installation policy.  Currently, nearly 2,300 living files are managed by the installation assistance system center.  Local management Lead and plan the activity of the division: definition of objectives and priorities, adaptation of the team's activities with regard to workloads, in conjunction with its line manager; Monitor the overall activity of the division and monitor the individual activity of the agents of the division; Provide technical and economic expertise in installation assistance files to managers, resolution of complex files; Organize and coordinate the various processes of the division in order to ensure fluidity in the processing of files; Organize the monitoring and implementation of the supervision and control processes of managers’ files; Propose budgetary developments and monitoring (commitments, payments) linked to this policy in connection with the Regional and FEADER budgets; Ensure day-to-day HR management in conjunction with your department manager; Ensure the replacement of the department manager during absence.  Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory; Organize and lead strategic meetings (regional installation committee in Normandy, meeting of prescribers, etc.); Represent the Region in strategic and field meetings for technical intervention and promotion of regional mechanisms; Provide technical-economic expertise to external requests for installation assistance files, as well as the liveability and viability of the installation projects presented; Monitor the evolution of current programming and its regulatory developments by being proactive in developing, modernizing and simplifying aid systems and their processes; Monitor the evaluation of the devices and its control methods; Design and update internal procedural documents, external documents intended for beneficiaries and partner structures of the installation, writing notes and reports Profile Expected skills Experience and knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, particularly agricultural and equine, and in particularly the analysis of the resulting economic data;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy.   Opportunities Joining the Normandy Region means joining a community that listens to its agents, offering in particular a social action system (CNAS membership), a restaurant voucher card (Caen), a concierge service, a prevention plan health at work as well as participation in a certified mutual insurance company and a nearby SNCF train station.  Recruitment conditions Remuneration according to statutory conditions + Compensation scheme. Vacant position to be filled as soon as possible according to the statutory recruitment procedures. The recruitment jury will be held in the second half of January 2025.

j.description: Description of the entityThe Department of Agriculture and Marine Resources (DARM) is responsible for supporting, implementing, leading, monitoring and adapting regional and European policies in the agricultural sector and forestry, the equine economy, fishing and aquaculture as well as the valorization of land and sea products. It includes 103 agents and is organized into 5 services, a sectoral steering mission European funds FEADER (European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development) / FEAMPA (European Fund for Maritime Affairs, Fisheries and Aquaculture) and an internal control unit.  The challenges for management are: Supporting Norman farmers in the development of their farms and transitions; Better valorize regional forest production; Give new impetus to Normandy fishing and move towards recognized and diversified Normandy aquaculture; Promote agricultural, fishing and aquaculture products; Support professionals in the equine industry and promote this sector of excellence internationally.   Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. In this context, the challenge for the community is therefore to support young people wishing to settle in Normandy with the aim of ensuring the maintenance of the number of agricultural and equine businesses in its territory and allowing generational renewal. As part of its new 2023-2027 program, the Region has set itself the objective of creating 450 installations per year in Normandy. Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy. j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside.
