The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. j.description: Description of the entityThe Department of Agriculture and Marine Resources (DARM) is responsible for supporting, implementing, leading, monitoring and adapting regional and European policies in the agricultural sector and forestry, the equine economy, fishing and aquaculture as well as the valorization of land and sea products. It includes 103 agents and is organized into 5 services, a sectoral steering mission European funds FEADER (European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development) / FEAMPA (European Fund for Maritime Affairs, Fisheries and Aquaculture) and an internal control unit.  The challenges for management are: Supporting Norman farmers in the development of their farms and transitions; Better valorize regional forest production; Give new impetus to Normandy fishing and move towards recognized and diversified Normandy aquaculture; Promote agricultural, fishing and aquaculture products; Support professionals in the equine industry and promote this sector of excellence internationally.   Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. In this context, the challenge for the community is therefore to support young people wishing to settle in Normandy with the aim of ensuring the maintenance of the number of agricultural and equine businesses in its territory and allowing generational renewal. As part of its new 2023-2027 program, the Region has set itself the objective of creating 450 installations per year in Normandy.  The purpose of this position is to provide local supervision to a team of managers responsible for examining installation assistance files and overseeing regional installation policy.  Currently, nearly 2,300 living files are managed by the installation assistance system center.  Local management Lead and plan the activity of the division: definition of objectives and priorities, adaptation of the team's activities with regard to workloads, in conjunction with its line manager; Monitor the overall activity of the division and monitor the individual activity of the agents of the division; Provide technical and economic expertise in installation assistance files to managers, resolution of complex files; Organize and coordinate the various processes of the division in order to ensure fluidity in the processing of files; Organize the monitoring and implementation of the supervision and control processes of managers’ files; Propose budgetary developments and monitoring (commitments, payments) linked to this policy in connection with the Regional and FEADER budgets; Ensure day-to-day HR management in conjunction with your department manager; Ensure the replacement of the department manager during absence.  Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory; Organize and lead strategic meetings (regional installation committee in Normandy, meeting of prescribers, etc.); Represent the Region in strategic and field meetings for technical intervention and promotion of regional mechanisms; Provide technical-economic expertise to external requests for installation assistance files, as well as the liveability and viability of the installation projects presented; Monitor the evolution of current programming and its regulatory developments by being proactive in developing, modernizing and simplifying aid systems and their processes; Monitor the evaluation of the devices and its control methods; Design and update internal procedural documents, external documents intended for beneficiaries and partner structures of the installation, writing notes and reports Profile Expected skills Experience and knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, particularly agricultural and equine, and in particularly the analysis of the resulting economic data;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy.   Opportunities Joining the Normandy Region means joining a community that listens to its agents, offering in particular a social action system (CNAS membership), a restaurant voucher card (Caen), a concierge service, a prevention plan health at work as well as participation in a certified mutual insurance company and a nearby SNCF train station.  Recruitment conditions Remuneration according to statutory conditions + Compensation scheme. Vacant position to be filled as soon as possible according to the statutory recruitment procedures. The recruitment jury will be held in the second half of January 2025.

j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

            "j.title: Responsable de p\u00f4le installation en agriculture (F/H)\nj.description: Description of the entityThe Department of Agriculture and Marine Resources (DARM) is responsible for supporting, implementing, leading, monitoring and adapting regional and European policies in the agricultural sector and forestry, the equine economy, fishing and aquaculture as well as the valorization of land and sea products. It includes 103 agents and is organized into 5 services, a sectoral steering mission European funds FEADER (European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development) / FEAMPA (European Fund for Maritime Affairs, Fisheries and Aquaculture) and an internal control unit.  The challenges for management are: Supporting Norman farmers in the development of their farms and transitions; Better valorize regional forest production; Give new impetus to Normandy fishing and move towards recognized and diversified Normandy aquaculture; Promote agricultural, fishing and aquaculture products; Support professionals in the equine industry and promote this sector of excellence internationally.   Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. In this context, the challenge for the community is therefore to support young people wishing to settle in Normandy with the aim of ensuring the maintenance of the number of agricultural and equine businesses in its territory and allowing generational renewal. As part of its new 2023-2027 program, the Region has set itself the objective of creating 450 installations per year in Normandy.  The purpose of this position is to provide local supervision to a team of managers responsible for examining installation assistance files and overseeing regional installation policy.  Currently, nearly 2,300 living files are managed by the installation assistance system center.  Local management Lead and plan the activity of the division: definition of objectives and priorities, adaptation of the team's activities with regard to workloads, in conjunction with its line manager; Monitor the overall activity of the division and monitor the individual activity of the agents of the division; Provide technical and economic expertise in installation assistance files to managers, resolution of complex files; Organize and coordinate the various processes of the division in order to ensure fluidity in the processing of files; Organize the monitoring and implementation of the supervision and control processes of managers\u2019 files; Propose budgetary developments and monitoring (commitments, payments) linked to this policy in connection with the Regional and FEADER budgets; Ensure day-to-day HR management in conjunction with your department manager; Ensure the replacement of the department manager during absence.  Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory; Organize and lead strategic meetings (regional installation committee in Normandy, meeting of prescribers, etc.); Represent the Region in strategic and field meetings for technical intervention and promotion of regional mechanisms; Provide technical-economic expertise to external requests for installation assistance files, as well as the liveability and viability of the installation projects presented; Monitor the evolution of current programming and its regulatory developments by being proactive in developing, modernizing and simplifying aid systems and their processes; Monitor the evaluation of the devices and its control methods; Design and update internal procedural documents, external documents intended for beneficiaries and partner structures of the installation, writing notes and reports Profile Expected skills Experience and knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, particularly agricultural and equine, and in particularly the analysis of the resulting economic data;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy.   Opportunities Joining the Normandy Region means joining a community that listens to its agents, offering in particular a social action system (CNAS membership), a restaurant voucher card (Caen), a concierge service, a prevention plan health at work as well as participation in a certified mutual insurance company and a nearby SNCF train station.  Recruitment conditions Remuneration according to statutory conditions + Compensation scheme. Vacant position to be filled as soon as possible according to the statutory recruitment procedures.             "j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business\nj.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara\u2022 compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, \u2022 support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, \u2022 follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, \u2022 increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, \u2022 be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - J\u00f6nk\u00f6ping/Landskrona\u2022 guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, \u2022 strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, \u2022 contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - J\u00f6nk\u00f6ping\u2022 what abilities are needed to run the business, \u2022 what vulnerabilities exist and \u2022 what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Link\u00f6ping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in J\u00f6nk\u00f6ping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in J\u00f6nk\u00f6ping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

turns.content: If someone specializes in animal production science, including animal nutrition, husbandry, and bio-security, what jobs can they find?

Based on the provided information, individuals with expertise in animal production, animal husbandry, nutrition, and related agricultural sciences can pursue several roles. These positions often involve advisory services, research, management, or technical support in the agricultural sector:

*   **Agricultural Adviser / Consultant:** Roles include providing expert advice to farms regarding cattle and crop production, specifically covering feed for milk and meat production, animal health, and welfare. (Examples: "Agricultural adviser to the Councilors in Sjuhärad" and "Växtodlingsrådgivare Dalarna").
*   **Expert / Project Manager in Animal Production:** These roles focus on gathering and transferring knowledge in areas such as milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, and feed. They act as a bridge between research and practical farm application. (Example: "Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production").
*   **Herd Manager:** This role involves the independent management of daily milking and stable operations, supervision of animal husbandry experiments, and instructing workers. (Example: "Herdenmanager m/w/d").
*   **Production Manager:** Responsible for managing modern livestock breeding units (e.g., sheep milking facilities). (Example: "MANAGER OF PRODUCTION").
*   **Land and Agricultural Estate Operations Director:** A leadership position overseeing all aspects of an estate, including livestock breeding, coordination of agroecological transitions, and administrative/financial management. (Example: "Land and Agricultural Estate Operations Director M/F").
*   **Agronomist (B2B Sales):** Positions focusing on the feed raw materials industry, requiring knowledge of the feed/livestock industry and the ability to manage clientele and sales contracts. (Example: "ΓΕΩΠΟΝΟΣ ΣΤΕΛΕΧΟΣ ΠΩΛΗΣΕΩΝ B2B").
*   **Agricultural Business Administration / Research Support:** Roles at research stations involving participation in experimental projects, data collection, and documentation related to both animal and plant production. (Example: "AGRARBETRIEBSWIRTIN/AGRARBETRIEBSWIRT").

**Key Qualifications noted for these roles include:**
*   University-level education in agriculture, agronomy, animal production, or veterinary science.
*   Specific expertise in feed value, breeding, production economics, and herd management.
*   Practical experience in animal husbandry and farm management.
*   Strong communication and relationship-building skills for advisory and B2B functions.

turns.content: What are the target occupations for a professional with this background?

Although the previous list provided a broader overview based on general agricultural expertise, the specific database context retrieved for this query identifies the following professions associated with animal-related skills (such as animal health, welfare, training, and handling):

*   **Animal Behaviourist:** Studies and assesses animal behaviour to prevent or address problematic behaviours through the development of suitable environments and management regimes.
*   **Animal Care Attendant:** Provides routine care for non-production animals, including feeding, watering, cleaning, grooming, and monitoring health and welfare.
*   **Veterinary Medicine Lecturer:** Instructs students in veterinary medicine, conducts academic research, and leads laboratory practices in an academic setting.
*   **Animal Artificial Insemination Technician:** Responsible for the impregnation of animals using collected semen.
*   **Live Animal Transporter:** Monitors the health and welfare of animals during transport and manages the loading, unloading, and journey planning.
*   **Animal Trainer:** Trains animals and handlers for purposes such as assistance, security, transportation, obedience, and education.
*   **Animal Therapist:** Provides therapeutic treatment to animals following a veterinary diagnosis or referral.
*   **Animal Handler:** Handles animals in a working role and continues their training.
*   **Veterinary Nurse:** Supports animals undergoing veterinary treatment and advises clients on animal health and disease prevention.
*   **Alternative Animal Therapist:** Investigates sick or injured animals and provides alternative healing treatments (e.g., homeopathy or acupuncture).
*   **Veterinary Technician:** Provides technical and administrative support to veterinarians.
*   **Animal Welfare Inspector:** Investigates reports of animal cruelty or neglect, rescues animals in risk, and educates owners on maintaining animal welfare.
*   **Specialised Veterinarian:** A professional with comprehensive scientific education authorized to carry out all aspects of veterinary medicine, often with expertise in a specific species or procedure.
*   **Official Veterinarian:** Focuses on public health, national disease eradication programs, and the movement/inspection of animals and animal products.
*   **General Veterinarian:** A professional authorized to carry out all aspects of veterinary medicine for various species, including equine, companion, or production animals.
*   **Animal Embryo Transfer Technician:** Aids and supports the carrying out of embryo transfers under veterinary supervision.

ID: http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/2de007c6-3223-4cd1-9561-e8a2e16e049d

They are responsible for national animal disease eradication programmes, the protection of public health and food or animal inspection, animal movements, and import and export of live animals and their products.

turns.content: What does a veterinary medicine lecturer or an animal behaviourist do according to the occupation descriptions?

Based on the database records provided, here are the responsibilities for those two roles:

*   **Veterinary medicine lecturer:** These professionals are subject professors, teachers, or lecturers (often doctors) who instruct students who have obtained an upper secondary education diploma in the specialized field of veterinary medicine. Their duties include:
    *   Preparing lectures and exams.
    *   Grading papers and exams.
    *   Leading laboratory practices.
    *   Leading review and feedback sessions for students.
    *   Conducting academic research in veterinary medicine and publishing their findings.
    *   Liaising with other university colleagues and working with university research and teaching assistants.

*   **Animal behaviourist:** These professionals work with animals and people to study, observe, assess, and understand animal behaviour in relation to specific factors. Their primary responsibilities are to:
    *   Prevent or address inappropriate or problematic behaviours in individual animals.
    *   Develop suitable environments and management regimes for animals, in accordance with national legislation.

j.description: Stockholm - Our capital with millions of dreams, expectations and ambitions. We work for everyone who lives here today and in the future. Now we are looking for you who want to think big, new and different with us - for the Stockholmers. The assignment includes everything from taking care of the existing urban environment to implementing strategic investment projects and planning for tomorrow's growing big city. To cope with our assignment, we are about 450 colleagues, who are mainly sitting in the Technical Board's newly renovated premises at Kungsholmen. Together, we ensure that Stockholm continues to be a city at the forefront of sustainable transport solutions and vibrant environments, both today and in the future. Tree specialist and unit manager. On the unit we work with the design of the city's public spaces such as streets, squares, parks and quays. Within the unit, we are also responsible for investment, operation and maintenance of all the city's street cleaners. We are in an expansive phase where a lot happens. Our questions, projects and budget assignments have been given more and more focus in recent years. As part of this focus, the traffic office is currently working on a program for urban cultivation. The program shows Stockholm City's will for long -term sustainable work with urban cultivation so that urban cultivation in Stockholm can increase and develop. There is a long tradition of cultivation in the city. Now we are looking for you who want to run the strategic work and develop urban cultivation in Stockholm. We offer a new, unique and exciting service for those who are passionate about cultivation, sustainable development and always have citizens' best in focus. We offer you a safe workplace where we help and support each other in everyday work and protect the good work environment. You are given the opportunity for personal development/skills replenishment as well as to participation and influence in the workplace. We have flexible working hours as well as the possibility of changing holiday allowance for extra leave. Depending on tasks and business needs, it is possible to alternate office work with working from home two days a week. Work environment and health are important to us. We offer health care compensation, wellness hours and the opportunity to participate in wellness activities. Read more about our benefits Hardin Roller as coordinator, you will have the strategic responsibility for the development of urban cultivation and for support on urban cultivation throughout the city, especially against the district boards. The role also involves collaboration with actors outside their own organization, in order to create more synergy effects around urban cultivation. Actors who need to be coordinated are, for example, the city management office, the technical administrations, the district administrations, the Stockholm Colonial Garden Association, housing companies, SVOA, police, other cultivation associations and growers.You are also responsible for practices for community cultivation and standardized conditions for leases or other agreements. If you show the need for new urban cultivations in the city, reviewing proposals for new facility and the development of new forms of urban cultivation according to new future needs. Project management and cross -sectoral collaboration ability to network and easy to associate new contacts with knowledge in the Office package and system experience to express yourself well in Swedish, both in speech and in writing. And agricultural interest in social sustainability and cultural history experience of/knowledge about application processes for external funds and grants that are relevant to the service. We are looking for you who are used to taking responsibility for your work and who independently structures and drives it forward. You are used to working towards goals and focus on results. We also see that you take your own initiative and make things happen. Since the service involves many contact areas, it is important that you are a responsive person who both appreciates and has the ability to collaborate with other people. We attach great importance to personal qualities, motivation and commitment to the service. Warm welcome with your application! Otherwise recruits without the personal letter, in this recruitment, to strengthen the focus on the skills and experiences in demand for this role. When assessing your application, we will only be based on your resume and a number of questions you may answer when you are applying for the service. We wish you to answer concrete and briefly to the questions, and that there is a clear link between your answers and your Cvdenna recruitment process will contain work psychological tests. Feel free to read more about the City of Stockholm that Employer Vi sees diversity as enriching and welcoming all applicants.Stockholm city works with skills -based recruitment aimed at ensuring each person's competence and thereby counteracting discrimination.

j.description: Stockholm - Our capital with millions of dreams, expectations and ambitions. We work for everyone who lives here today and in the future. Now we are looking for you who want to think big, new and different with us - for the Stockholmers. The assignment includes everything from taking care of the existing urban environment to implementing strategic investment projects and planning for tomorrow's growing big city. To cope with our assignment, we are about 450 colleagues, who are mainly sitting in the Technical Board's newly renovated premises at Kungsholmen. Together, we ensure that Stockholm continues to be a city at the forefront of sustainable transport solutions and vibrant environments, both today and in the future. Tree specialist and unit manager. On the unit we work with the design of the city's public spaces such as streets, squares, parks and quays. Within the unit, we are also responsible for investment, operation and maintenance of all the city's street cleaners. We are in an expansive phase where a lot happens. Our questions, projects and budget assignments have been given more and more focus in recent years. As part of this focus, the traffic office is currently working on a program for urban cultivation. The program shows Stockholm City's will for long -term sustainable work with urban cultivation so that urban cultivation in Stockholm can increase and develop. There is a long tradition of cultivation in the city. Now we are looking for you who want to run the strategic work and develop urban cultivation in Stockholm. We offer a new, unique and exciting service for those who are passionate about cultivation, sustainable development and always have citizens' best in focus. We offer you a safe workplace where we help and support each other in everyday work and protect the good work environment. You are given the opportunity for personal development/skills replenishment as well as to participation and influence in the workplace. We have flexible working hours as well as the possibility of changing holiday allowance for extra leave. Depending on tasks and business needs, it is possible to alternate office work with working from home two days a week. Work environment and health are important to us. We offer health care compensation, wellness hours and the opportunity to participate in wellness activities. Read more about our benefits Hardin Roller as coordinator, you will have the strategic responsibility for the development of urban cultivation and for support on urban cultivation throughout the city, especially against the district boards. The role also involves collaboration with actors outside their own organization, in order to create more synergy effects around urban cultivation. Actors who need to be coordinated are, for example, the city management office, the technical administrations, the district administrations, the Stockholm Colonial Garden Association, housing companies, SVOA, police, other cultivation associations and growers.You are also responsible for practices for community cultivation and standardized conditions for leases or other agreements. If you show the need for new urban cultivations in the city, reviewing proposals for new facility and the development of new forms of urban cultivation according to new future needs. Project management and cross -sectoral collaboration ability to network and easy to associate new contacts with knowledge in the Office package and system experience to express yourself well in Swedish, both in speech and in writing. And agricultural interest in social sustainability and cultural history experience of/knowledge about application processes for external funds and grants that are relevant to the service. We are looking for you who are used to taking responsibility for your work and who independently structures and drives it forward. You are used to working towards goals and focus on results. We also see that you take your own initiative and make things happen. Since the service involves many contact areas, it is important that you are a responsive person who both appreciates and has the ability to collaborate with other people. We attach great importance to personal qualities, motivation and commitment to the service. Warm welcome with your application! Otherwise recruits without the personal letter, in this recruitment, to strengthen the focus on the skills and experiences in demand for this role. When assessing your application, we will only be based on your resume and a number of questions you may answer when you are applying for the service. We wish you to answer concrete and briefly to the questions, and that there is a clear link between your answers and your Cvdenna recruitment process will contain work psychological tests. Feel free to read more about the City of Stockholm that Employer Vi sees diversity as enriching and welcoming all applicants.Stockholm city works with skills -based recruitment aimed at ensuring each person's competence and thereby counteracting discrimination.

### Skills for Pesticides Sprayer

j.description: Stockholm - Our capital with millions of dreams, expectations and ambitions. We work for everyone who lives here today and in the future. Now we are looking for you who want to think big, new and different with us - for the Stockholmers. The assignment includes everything from taking care of the existing urban environment to implementing strategic investment projects and planning for tomorrow's growing big city. To cope with our assignment, we are about 450 colleagues, who are mainly sitting in the Technical Board's newly renovated premises at Kungsholmen. Together, we ensure that Stockholm continues to be a city at the forefront of sustainable transport solutions and vibrant environments, both today and in the future. Tree specialist and unit manager. On the unit we work with the design of the city's public spaces such as streets, squares, parks and quays. Within the unit, we are also responsible for investment, operation and maintenance of all the city's street cleaners. We are in an expansive phase where a lot happens. Our questions, projects and budget assignments have been given more and more focus in recent years. As part of this focus, the traffic office is currently working on a program for urban cultivation. The program shows Stockholm City's will for long -term sustainable work with urban cultivation so that urban cultivation in Stockholm can increase and develop. There is a long tradition of cultivation in the city. Now we are looking for you who want to run the strategic work and develop urban cultivation in Stockholm. We offer a new, unique and exciting service for those who are passionate about cultivation, sustainable development and always have citizens' best in focus. We offer you a safe workplace where we help and support each other in everyday work and protect the good work environment. You are given the opportunity for personal development/skills replenishment as well as to participation and influence in the workplace. We have flexible working hours as well as the possibility of changing holiday allowance for extra leave. Depending on tasks and business needs, it is possible to alternate office work with working from home two days a week. Work environment and health are important to us. We offer health care compensation, wellness hours and the opportunity to participate in wellness activities. Read more about our benefits Hardin Roller as coordinator, you will have the strategic responsibility for the development of urban cultivation and for support on urban cultivation throughout the city, especially against the district boards. The role also involves collaboration with actors outside their own organization, in order to create more synergy effects around urban cultivation. Actors who need to be coordinated are, for example, the city management office, the technical administrations, the district administrations, the Stockholm Colonial Garden Association, housing companies, SVOA, police, other cultivation associations and growers.You are also responsible for practices for community cultivation and standardized conditions for leases or other agreements. If you show the need for new urban cultivations in the city, reviewing proposals for new facility and the development of new forms of urban cultivation according to new future needs. Project management and cross -sectoral collaboration ability to network and easy to associate new contacts with knowledge in the Office package and system experience to express yourself well in Swedish, both in speech and in writing. And agricultural interest in social sustainability and cultural history experience of/knowledge about application processes for external funds and grants that are relevant to the service. We are looking for you who are used to taking responsibility for your work and who independently structures and drives it forward. You are used to working towards goals and focus on results. We also see that you take your own initiative and make things happen. Since the service involves many contact areas, it is important that you are a responsive person who both appreciates and has the ability to collaborate with other people. We attach great importance to personal qualities, motivation and commitment to the service. Warm welcome with your application! Otherwise recruits without the personal letter, in this recruitment, to strengthen the focus on the skills and experiences in demand for this role. When assessing your application, we will only be based on your resume and a number of questions you may answer when you are applying for the service. We wish you to answer concrete and briefly to the questions, and that there is a clear link between your answers and your Cvdenna recruitment process will contain work psychological tests. Feel free to read more about the City of Stockholm that Employer Vi sees diversity as enriching and welcoming all applicants.Stockholm city works with skills -based recruitment aimed at ensuring each person's competence and thereby counteracting discrimination.

j.description: Stockholm - Our capital with millions of dreams, expectations and ambitions. We work for everyone who lives here today and in the future. Now we are looking for you who want to think big, new and different with us - for the Stockholmers. The assignment includes everything from taking care of the existing urban environment to implementing strategic investment projects and planning for tomorrow's growing big city. To cope with our assignment, we are about 450 colleagues, who are mainly sitting in the Technical Board's newly renovated premises at Kungsholmen. Together, we ensure that Stockholm continues to be a city at the forefront of sustainable transport solutions and vibrant environments, both today and in the future. Tree specialist and unit manager. On the unit we work with the design of the city's public spaces such as streets, squares, parks and quays. Within the unit, we are also responsible for investment, operation and maintenance of all the city's street cleaners. We are in an expansive phase where a lot happens. Our questions, projects and budget assignments have been given more and more focus in recent years. As part of this focus, the traffic office is currently working on a program for urban cultivation. The program shows Stockholm City's will for long -term sustainable work with urban cultivation so that urban cultivation in Stockholm can increase and develop. There is a long tradition of cultivation in the city. Now we are looking for you who want to run the strategic work and develop urban cultivation in Stockholm. We offer a new, unique and exciting service for those who are passionate about cultivation, sustainable development and always have citizens' best in focus. We offer you a safe workplace where we help and support each other in everyday work and protect the good work environment. You are given the opportunity for personal development/skills replenishment as well as to participation and influence in the workplace. We have flexible working hours as well as the possibility of changing holiday allowance for extra leave. Depending on tasks and business needs, it is possible to alternate office work with working from home two days a week. Work environment and health are important to us. We offer health care compensation, wellness hours and the opportunity to participate in wellness activities. Read more about our benefits Hardin Roller as coordinator, you will have the strategic responsibility for the development of urban cultivation and for support on urban cultivation throughout the city, especially against the district boards. The role also involves collaboration with actors outside their own organization, in order to create more synergy effects around urban cultivation. Actors who need to be coordinated are, for example, the city management office, the technical administrations, the district administrations, the Stockholm Colonial Garden Association, housing companies, SVOA, police, other cultivation associations and growers.You are also responsible for practices for community cultivation and standardized conditions for leases or other agreements. If you show the need for new urban cultivations in the city, reviewing proposals for new facility and the development of new forms of urban cultivation according to new future needs. Project management and cross -sectoral collaboration ability to network and easy to associate new contacts with knowledge in the Office package and system experience to express yourself well in Swedish, both in speech and in writing. And agricultural interest in social sustainability and cultural history experience of/knowledge about application processes for external funds and grants that are relevant to the service. We are looking for you who are used to taking responsibility for your work and who independently structures and drives it forward. You are used to working towards goals and focus on results. We also see that you take your own initiative and make things happen. Since the service involves many contact areas, it is important that you are a responsive person who both appreciates and has the ability to collaborate with other people. We attach great importance to personal qualities, motivation and commitment to the service. Warm welcome with your application! Otherwise recruits without the personal letter, in this recruitment, to strengthen the focus on the skills and experiences in demand for this role. When assessing your application, we will only be based on your resume and a number of questions you may answer when you are applying for the service. We wish you to answer concrete and briefly to the questions, and that there is a clear link between your answers and your Cvdenna recruitment process will contain work psychological tests. Feel free to read more about the City of Stockholm that Employer Vi sees diversity as enriching and welcoming all applicants.Stockholm city works with skills -based recruitment aimed at ensuring each person's competence and thereby counteracting discrimination.

j.title: Samordnare för stadsnära odling
j.description: Stockholm - Our capital with millions of dreams, expectations and ambitions. We work for everyone who lives here today and in the future. Now we are looking for you who want to think big, new and different with us - for the Stockholmers. The assignment includes everything from taking care of the existing urban environment to implementing strategic investment projects and planning for tomorrow's growing big city. To cope with our assignment, we are about 450 colleagues, who are mainly sitting in the Technical Board's newly renovated premises at Kungsholmen. Together, we ensure that Stockholm continues to be a city at the forefront of sustainable transport solutions and vibrant environments, both today and in the future. Tree specialist and unit manager. On the unit we work with the design of the city's public spaces such as streets, squares, parks and quays. Within the unit, we are also responsible for investment, operation and maintenance of all the city's street cleaners. We are in an expansive phase where a lot happens. Our questions, projects and budget assignments have been given more and more focus in recent years. As part of this focus, the traffic office is currently working on a program for urban cultivation. The program shows Stockholm City's will for long -term sustainable work with urban cultivation so that urban cultivation in Stockholm can increase and develop. There is a long tradition of cultivation in the city. Now we are looking for you who want to run the strategic work and develop urban cultivation in Stockholm. We offer a new, unique and exciting service for those who are passionate about cultivation, sustainable development and always have citizens' best in focus. We offer you a safe workplace where we help and support each other in everyday work and protect the good work environment. You are given the opportunity for personal development/skills replenishment as well as to participation and influence in the workplace. We have flexible working hours as well as the possibility of changing holiday allowance for extra leave. Depending on tasks and business needs, it is possible to alternate office work with working from home two days a week. Work environment and health are important to us. We offer health care compensation, wellness hours and the opportunity to participate in wellness activities. Read more about our benefits Hardin Roller as coordinator, you will have the strategic responsibility for the development of urban cultivation and for support on urban cultivation throughout the city, especially against the district boards. The role also involves collaboration with actors outside their own organization, in order to create more synergy effects around urban cultivation. Actors who need to be coordinated are, for example, the city management office, the technical administrations, the district administrations, the Stockholm Colonial Garden Association, housing companies, SVOA, police, other cultivation associations and growers.You are also responsible for practices for community cultivation and standardized conditions for leases or other agreements. If you show the need for new urban cultivations in the city, reviewing proposals for new facility and the development of new forms of urban cultivation according to new future needs. Project management and cross -sectoral collaboration ability to network and easy to associate new contacts with knowledge in the Office package and system experience to express yourself well in Swedish, both in speech and in writing. And agricultural interest in social sustainability and cultural history experience of/knowledge about application processes for external funds and grants that are relevant to the service. We are looking for you who are used to taking responsibility for your work and who independently structures and drives it forward. You are used to working towards goals and focus on results. We also see that you take your own initiative and make things happen. Since the service involves many contact areas, it is important that you are a responsive person who both appreciates and has the ability to collaborate with other people. We attach great importance to personal qualities, motivation and commitment to the service. Warm welcome with your application! Otherwise recruits without the personal letter, in this recruitment, to strengthen the focus on the skills and experiences in demand for this role. When assessing your application, we will only be based on your resume and a number of questions you may answer when you are applying for the service. We wish you to answer concrete and briefly to the questions, and that there is a clear link between your answers and your Cvdenna recruitment process will contain work psychological tests. Feel free to read more about the City of Stockholm that Employer Vi sees diversity as enriching and welcoming all applicants.Stockholm city works with skills -based recruitment aimed at ensuring each person's competence and thereby counteracting discrimination.

The skills shared or associated with these roles reflect a combination of management, technical, and regulatory expertise. Below are the descriptions of the skills retrieved from the database:

### Core Skills and Descriptions

**Business and Management Skills**
*   **Abide by business ethical code of conducts:** Conform to ethical standards promoted by companies and ensure that operations throughout the supply chain comply with these codes.

**Agronomic and Technical Skills**

*   **Advise on soil and water protection:** Advise on methods to prevent pollution (such as nitrate leaching) and protect against soil erosion.
*   **European pesticide legislation:** Knowledge of the EU framework promoting the sustainable use of pesticides.

**Operational and Professional Skills**
*   **Accept own accountability:** Recognise the limits of one’s own practice and take responsibility for professional activities.
*   **Accounting:** Documentation and processing of data regarding financial activities.
*   **Agricultural equipment:** Understanding the functionalities, properties, and regulatory requirements of agricultural machinery.
*   **Apply horticultural standards and practices:** Establishing and maintaining standards, including providing direction and training for staff.
*   **Apply safety procedures in laboratory:** Ensuring laboratory equipment is used safely and samples are handled correctly to ensure valid results.
*   **Archive scientific documentation:** Using systems to store protocols and analysis results for future research reference.

turns.content: Which occupations, like pesticides sprayer or aquaculture harvesting worker, are expected to practice this skill?

Based on the retrieved database information, I can provide the specific skills and descriptions for the occupations **pesticides sprayer** and **aquaculture harvesting worker**. 

While these two roles have distinct areas of expertise—one focusing on chemical application and plant protection, and the other on fishery operations and animal welfare—they share the foundational skill of **cooperating with colleagues**.

### Shared Skill: Cooperate with colleagues
*   **Description:** Cooperate with colleagues in order to ensure that operations run effectively.

***

### Skills for Pesticides Sprayer
The pesticides sprayer is expected to master skills related to chemical safety, equipment maintenance, and plant health:
*   **Pest and Chemical Control:** Integrated pest management, safe use of pesticides, mix chemicals, perform pest control, perform weed control operations, and manage pest and weed control.
*   **Operational Equipment:** Use pest detection sensors, pesticides sprayers, herbicides sprayers, perform safety inspections on spraying equipment, and clean equipment.
*   **Horticultural Knowledge:** Horticulture principles, floriculture, plant disease control, and handling chemical products for soil and plants.
*   **Safety and Regulations:** Select hazard control, use personal protection equipment, health, safety and hygiene legislation, European pesticide legislation, and work safely with chemicals.
*   **Environment & Admin:** Adapt to different weather conditions, work in outdoor conditions, maintain inventory of pesticides, maintain professional administration, and complete report sheets of activity.

### Skills for Aquaculture Harvesting Worker
The aquaculture harvesting worker is expected to master skills related to aquatic resource management, water quality, and livestock handling:
*   **Fish Management:** Fish identification and classification, identity aquaculture species, monitor aquaculture feeding behaviour, implement fin fish feeding regimes, monitor fish mortality rates, and screen live fish deformities.
*   **Harvesting Operations:** Apply fish harvest methods, set up fish harvesting equipment, perform fish grading operations, operate fish capture equipment, harvest aquatic resources, and handle harvested fish.
*   **Environment & Maintenance:** Measure water quality parameters, measure water flow, maintain fish harvesting equipment, collect broodstock, collect dead fish, and handle fish harvesting waste.
*   **Safety and Professionalism:** Follow hygienic practices in fishery operations, follow safety precautions in fishery operations, fish welfare regulations, biosecurity, and undertake continuous professional development in fishery operations.
*   **Logistics & Communication:** Operate small craft, prepare for small craft operation, operation of transport equipment, transport fish, communicate verbal instructions, and report to the team leader.
