As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. j.description: Do you want to be part of driving Lantmännen Lantbruk's plant growing business forward in northern Sweden? Do you have a great interest in agriculture? Then this is the role for you! We are now looking for a committed and driven Regional Manager for the northern region. Here you get the opportunity to be part of a successful team where we combine ambition and humility. In Lantmännen's group, agriculture is the heart and the core business that forms the basis of our entire broad business. With our unique value chain, we take responsibility from farm to table every day. This is what you will do As Regional Manager in the North, you are Lantmännen's face in the region, both to customers/members and other stakeholders. You lead a committed team of crop salesmen who are spread out in northern Sweden, from the coast to the inland. The crop sellers sell crop supplies and buy grain. Your main task is to develop the business together with colleagues in crop cultivation, grain purchasing and feed and ensure that we meet the needs of both customers and members. You work closely with product managers and product developers to continuously improve our offer with the customer's perspective in focus. You prepare and implement long-term sales plans and are responsible for your team reaching set goals and budgets, both in terms of volume and profitability.  You start from one of Lantmännen Lanbruk's sales offices in Mälardalen. The role involves travel within the region to work closely with both your team and our customers. You report to Lantmännen's crop production manager. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have a genuine interest in agriculture and business development. Post-secondary agricultural education or equivalent experience in the field. Experience in sales and working to a budget. Previous experience in leading and developing teams.  You are relationship-building and find it easy to build effective and positive collaborations. A clear leader who listens and adapts your leadership to the situation. Motivating and inspiring with the ability to make others succeed. Results-oriented, self-motivated and focused on achieving goals. Energetic and a positive force in meeting others.  You share our values: holistic view, openness and action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting role where you get the opportunity to both develop and be developed. At Lantmännen, you become part of a global group with a unique value chain and exciting career opportunities. We also have a strong focus on diversity and inclusion - here everyone should feel welcome and included. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 2nd. In your application, you have the option to add your CV or LinkedIn profile. For a more objective and inclusive recruitment process, we do not accept personal letters, but instead ask you to answer selection questions that are relevant to the position. The recruitment process includes both psychometric tests and competency-based interviews, with the aim of promoting a fair evaluation for all candidates. At Lantmännen, it is important that everyone has equal opportunities for employment and development in the group. As a final candidate, a background check will be carried out via our supplier ToFindOut. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are most welcome to contact Talent Acquisition Specialist, Matilda Olbin at matilda.olbin@lantmannen.com. j.title: Sales manager north, Väktodling
j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!', 'j.id: 1631314

Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions. Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States. Our employees reflect the diversity of our customers, the markets where we operate and the communities which we serve. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet. j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. j.title: Tractor and Machine Operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. j.title: Traktorförare Säsong 2025
j.description: For Framtidsgården Bjertorp, we are now looking for you with a great interest in the agriculture of the future and who wants to work in an engaging and happy team with a fast pace during the season 2025. Bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruk's Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We run a modern and rational agriculture on 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens Egendom, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and the development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition to this, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The trial operation covers approximately 20 hectares and 6,000 trial plots which are distributed over the farm's area. The position is a seasonal position for the 2025 season, starting April 1 and running until October 31. There is the possibility of extension, and access is by agreement. This is what you will do. Together with other staff, you will primarily manage the operations to be carried out on a crop farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and fodder harvesting in Viken. You will also help with the sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loader driving and machine maintenance occurs. All work in the field is carried out with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest machine technology to ensure high efficiency, precision and durability. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have: An agricultural education (or several years of experience in the profession) Experience of driving machinery and a great interest in agriculture B driver's license Good knowledge of the Swedish language You are: Responsible and thorough in your work A team player who can cooperate with others in your environment, but who can also work independently Spraying certificate is a merit You shares our values ​​Openness, Holistic view and Action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you will have the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment takes place according to agreement, with a desirable start date from 1 April to 31 October. There is the possibility of an extension. The location of the position is Kvänum, where you will report to the operations manager. If necessary, housing is available. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28, 2025. Selection takes place continuously. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com. j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.", 'j.id: 1787132
j.title: Försökstekniker
j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. j.title: Agronom, Forslundagymnasiet
j.description: Forslunda high school is located in a beautiful rural environment only 5 km from the center of Umeå. The high school has about 130 students, an adapted high school about 30 students and adult education in gardening, land and construction with about 80 students. The school runs its own modern farm, with around 60 dairy cows, calves and a herd of sheep. There are 170 ha of arable land for crop cultivation, where everything today is produced organically. The milk that Forslunda delivers to Norrmejerier is organic. The school also has a horse stable, dog training hall and an animal house with around 100 different species of small animals. There is also a student dormitory at the school. Your dutiesTeaching in crop cultivation, soil and plant biology. You carry out planning together with the operations manager in the plant cultivation at Forslunda as well as other tasks within agriculture and natural farming high school. You belong to a work team together with other teachers who are responsible for the education of our students. Together with your colleagues, you are responsible for running and developing the educational work based on the curriculum and the goals of the business, as well as in collaboration with other staff in the business. We would like for you to have teaching training with competence in farm animals and experience of teaching students or other leadership roles within, for example, association life. You have great collaboration skills and are solution-focused. You have the ability to find yourself in many different contexts, you see opportunities and like when a lot is happening around you. We are looking for you who want to support and motivate our students both in their knowledge and personal development. You are a person who creates good relationships and feels confident teaching students. You are a team player who prioritizes dialogue and is thorough and structured in your way of working. The position requires a valid extract from the employment register. For this position, a B driver's license is required. the region's largest employer with over 13,000 employees. j.description: The County Administrative Board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to safeguard the qualities that diversity adds the business. The country countryside unit is one of the County Administrative Board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic payment services. Within the unit there is also Interreg Sweden the Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sectoral cooperation on the county administrative board. With us, experts work in these areas who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness to the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! Descriptions The newly formed function of agricultural support we are now looking for a manager. The function consists of between 10 -15 Employees depending on the season and work mainly with handling and control of animal and area-based support for agriculture, register checks on animals and land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties. The function also participates in cross -sectoral collaborations on the county administrative board and acts as experts when answering referrals and when preparing various issues linked to the county's agriculture. Work tasks as a function manager will be your role to lead the work based on our assignment and in accordance with the county administrative board's overall priorities. In daily work, you are a present manager who practices a trust -based leadership to create a good workplace for your employees and colleagues. You have target and results responsibility for the function and work closely with the unit manager and deputy unit manager on issues related to financial follow-up and strategic planning. You are part of the unit's management team and together with other managers take overall responsibility for the unit's operations and development. Collaborations with other function managers on the county administrative board and in cross -sectoral working groups are a natural part of your work. In addition to your managerial assignment you will also work with other tasks that are included in the operation of the function or unit. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. You communicate and handle any conflicts in a constructive way, are loyal to your mission and have a positive attitude towards your work.  You can weigh complex information and show judgment in statements, actions and decisions. The work requires that you are structured and can plan, organize and prioritize in an appropriate way, you set up and keep time frames for your work. In order to succeed in the role, it is important to be able to collaborate with both people on the unit and other units and to be able to see whole and take into account a larger perspective. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference for our county and society. The County Administrative Board is a broad authority, which means that you are constantly being given the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a great focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health promotion wellness activities. We care about collaboration with our trade union parties and can offer distance work. Depending on service, it may include service in crisis staff and security rating. We usually start with probationary employment at permanent services.information on how we process your personal data can be found at www.lansstyrelsen.se/datasktkt", "j.id: 1739844

j.description: About the company Roslätt farm, with a long history, is located in a very attractive landscape with meadows, forest groves and coastal forests down towards Yddingesjön in the east. The family farm is located in beautiful natural surroundings, where we run a versatile business with a focus on sustainability and tradition. We are now looking for an independent and responsible farm manager who wants to live on the farm and be an important part of our team in an inspiring and varied work environment. We offer good working conditions and a stable and long-term job. Your duties As farm manager you will have overall responsibility for the daily operation and maintenance of the farm. You will be the one who makes sure that everything from buildings and land to gardens, crops and deer fences are looked after in the best way. You will have varied and independent work, where you both plan and carry out tasks. You cooperate with other staff on the farm.- Daily supervision of buildings, machines, land and gardens.- Responsible for gardening, crops and deer fences depending on the season.- Carry out simple repairs on buildings, machines and equipment.- Manage certain purchases.- On on the farm there is a straw boiler that requires some supervision. - Be available for urgent matters and problems that may arise. Your background/Your characteristics We are looking for you who want to live in the country and live life in in nature! You have experience in farm work, agriculture or similar tasks. Are handy and self-motivated and have good knowledge of maintenance of buildings and machines. It is important that you are flexible and prepared to take overall responsibility for the management of the farm. You will thrive best if you are responsible, solution-oriented and confident in organizing your work. Meriting is if you have a hunting degree and chainsaw training. Information and contact Living on the farm This position includes living on the farm, which gives you the opportunity to quickly get to duties and be available when needed. We offer well-equipped accommodation, 6 rooms and kitchen, which is close to the work area. Here you have the opportunity to enjoy both nature and work without having to travel far. Rent according to agreement, where the accommodation is part of the package as Farm Manager. Car and fuel are included in the service. Farming and hunting are leased out. An external actor is responsible for the farm's forestry. If you have questions about the position or accommodation, please contact Lisbeth Ahlkvist, 046-5408592. About Wikan PersonalWikan Personal is your personal and local employer in the staffing industry. Our broad contact network helps you, who have the right attitude and skills, to work. We operate in several different industries, which opens many doors for you in your search for your next job. We focus on our staff, their well-being and development. We know personnel. Wikan Personnel's business is based on closeness and commitment to always be able to provide good service to our customers and employees. We are deeply convinced that local anchoring, long-term customer relations and competent employees are the key to successful collaborations in the recruitment and staffing industry. With a presence in 14 locations in Sweden, a turnover of around SEK 400 million and around 800 dedicated employees, we strive to be a reliable partner. Read more at www.wikan.se", 'j.id: 1812660

j.title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property
j.description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. More information about the institution/department: https://internal. sly see/Organisation-och-styrningen/organisation/gemensamma-verkehsamstodet/egendomsavdelningen/lantbruksdriften/Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www. sly se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Lanna research station, Saleby, Lidköping Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment. Scope: 100% Access: By agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 12/16/2024. Union contact persons: https://internal. sly see/my-anstalling/union/contacts/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and PhD students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.", "j.id: 1854335
j.title: Regionchef
j.description: Do you want to be part of driving Lantmännen Lantbruk's plant growing business forward in northern Sweden? Do you have a great interest in agriculture? Then this is the role for you! We are now looking for a committed and driven Regional Manager for the northern region. Here you get the opportunity to be part of a successful team where we combine ambition and humility. In Lantmännen's group, agriculture is the heart and the core business that forms the basis of our entire broad business. With our unique value chain, we take responsibility from farm to table every day. This is what you will do As Regional Manager in the North, you are Lantmännen's face in the region, both to customers/members and other stakeholders. You lead a committed team of crop salesmen who are spread out in northern Sweden, from the coast to the inland. The crop sellers sell crop supplies and buy grain. Your main task is to develop the business together with colleagues in crop cultivation, grain purchasing and feed and ensure that we meet the needs of both customers and members. You work closely with product managers and product developers to continuously improve our offer with the customer's perspective in focus. You prepare and implement long-term sales plans and are responsible for your team reaching set goals and budgets, both in terms of volume and profitability.  You start from one of Lantmännen Lanbruk's sales offices in Mälardalen. The role involves travel within the region to work closely with both your team and our customers. You report to Lantmännen's crop production manager. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have a genuine interest in agriculture and business development. Post-secondary agricultural education or equivalent experience in the field. Experience in sales and working to a budget. Previous experience in leading and developing teams.  You are relationship-building and find it easy to build effective and positive collaborations. A clear leader who listens and adapts your leadership to the situation. Motivating and inspiring with the ability to make others succeed. Results-oriented, self-motivated and focused on achieving goals. Energetic and a positive force in meeting others.  You share our values: holistic view, openness and action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting role where you get the opportunity to both develop and be developed. At Lantmännen, you become part of a global group with a unique value chain and exciting career opportunities. We also have a strong focus on diversity and inclusion - here everyone should feel welcome and included. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 2nd. In your application, you have the option to add your CV or LinkedIn profile. For a more objective and inclusive recruitment process, we do not accept personal letters, but instead ask you to answer selection questions that are relevant to the position. The recruitment process includes both psychometric tests and competency-based interviews, with the aim of promoting a fair evaluation for all candidates. At Lantmännen, it is important that everyone has equal opportunities for employment and development in the group. As a final candidate, a background check will be carried out via our supplier ToFindOut. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are most welcome to contact Talent Acquisition Specialist, Matilda Olbin at matilda.olbin@lantmannen.com. We look forward to your application!Contact personMatilda Olbinmatilda.olbin@lantmannen.com", 'j.id: 123970

j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!', 'j.id: 1631314

j.title: Traktorförare Säsong 2025
j.description: For Framtidsgården Bjertorp, we are now looking for you with a great interest in the agriculture of the future and who wants to work in an engaging and happy team with a fast pace during the season 2025. Bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruk's Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We run a modern and rational agriculture on 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens Egendom, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and the development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition to this, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The trial operation covers approximately 20 hectares and 6,000 trial plots which are distributed over the farm's area. The position is a seasonal position for the 2025 season, starting April 1 and running until October 31. There is the possibility of extension, and access is by agreement. This is what you will do. Together with other staff, you will primarily manage the operations to be carried out on a crop farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and fodder harvesting in Viken. You will also help with the sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loader driving and machine maintenance occurs. All work in the field is carried out with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest machine technology to ensure high efficiency, precision and durability. Qualifications This is what you need to succeed and thrive You have: An agricultural education (or several years of experience in the profession) Experience of driving machinery and a great interest in agriculture B driver's license Good knowledge of the Swedish language You are: Responsible and thorough in your work A team player who can cooperate with others in your environment, but who can also work independently Spraying certificate is a merit You shares our values ​​Openness, Holistic view and Action - and our promise to take responsibility from farm to table. What we offer you An exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you will have the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment takes place according to agreement, with a desirable start date from 1 April to 31 October. There is the possibility of an extension. The location of the position is Kvänum, where you will report to the operations manager. If necessary, housing is available. Does that sound interesting? We hope so! You apply for the position online, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28, 2025. Selection takes place continuously. If you have questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com. j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.", 'j.id: 1787132
j.title: Försökstekniker
j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. j.description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. j.title: Sales manager north, Väktodling
j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!', 'j.id: 1631314
