otherJob.description: Description of the entityThe Department of Agriculture and Marine Resources (DARM) is responsible for supporting, implementing, leading, monitoring and adapting regional and European policies in the agricultural sector and forestry, the equine economy, fishing and aquaculture as well as the valorization of land and sea products. It includes 103 agents and is organized into 5 services, a sectoral steering mission European funds FEADER (European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development) / FEAMPA (European Fund for Maritime Affairs, Fisheries and Aquaculture) and an internal control unit.  The challenges for management are: Supporting Norman farmers in the development of their farms and transitions; Better valorize regional forest production; Give new impetus to Normandy fishing and move towards recognized and diversified Normandy aquaculture; Promote agricultural, fishing and aquaculture products; Support professionals in the equine industry and promote this sector of excellence internationally.   Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. In this context, the challenge for the community is therefore to support young people wishing to settle in Normandy with the aim of ensuring the maintenance of the number of agricultural and equine businesses in its territory and allowing generational renewal. As part of its new 2023-2027 program, the Region has set itself the objective of creating 450 installations per year in Normandy.  The purpose of this position is to provide local supervision to a team of managers responsible for examining installation assistance files and overseeing regional installation policy.  Currently, nearly 2,300 living files are managed by the installation assistance system center.  Local management Lead and plan the activity of the division: definition of objectives and priorities, adaptation of the team's activities with regard to workloads, in conjunction with its line manager; Monitor the overall activity of the division and monitor the individual activity of the agents of the division; Provide technical and economic expertise in installation assistance files to managers, resolution of complex files; Organize and coordinate the various processes of the division in order to ensure fluidity in the processing of files; Organize the monitoring and implementation of the supervision and control processes of managers’ files; Propose budgetary developments and monitoring (commitments, payments) linked to this policy in connection with the Regional and FEADER budgets; Ensure day-to-day HR management in conjunction with your department manager; Ensure the replacement of the department manager during absence.  Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory; Organize and lead strategic meetings (regional installation committee in Normandy, meeting of prescribers, etc.); Represent the Region in strategic and field meetings for technical intervention and promotion of regional mechanisms; Provide technical-economic expertise to external requests for installation assistance files, as well as the liveability and viability of the installation projects presented; Monitor the evolution of current programming and its regulatory developments by being proactive in developing, modernizing and simplifying aid systems and their processes; Monitor the evaluation of the devices and its control methods; Design and update internal procedural documents, external documents intended for beneficiaries and partner structures of the installation, writing notes and reports Profile Expected skills Experience and knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, particularly agricultural and equine, and in particularly the analysis of the resulting economic data;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy. otherJob.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. otherJob.description: Description of the entityThe Department of Agriculture and Marine Resources (DARM) is responsible for supporting, implementing, leading, monitoring and adapting regional and European policies in the agricultural sector and forestry, the equine economy, fishing and aquaculture as well as the valorization of land and sea products. It includes 103 agents and is organized into 5 services, a sectoral steering mission European funds FEADER (European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development) / FEAMPA (European Fund for Maritime Affairs, Fisheries and Aquaculture) and an internal control unit.  The challenges for management are: Supporting Norman farmers in the development of their farms and transitions; Better valorize regional forest production; Give new impetus to Normandy fishing and move towards recognized and diversified Normandy aquaculture; Promote agricultural, fishing and aquaculture products; Support professionals in the equine industry and promote this sector of excellence internationally.   Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. In this context, the challenge for the community is therefore to support young people wishing to settle in Normandy with the aim of ensuring the maintenance of the number of agricultural and equine businesses in its territory and allowing generational renewal. As part of its new 2023-2027 program, the Region has set itself the objective of creating 450 installations per year in Normandy.  The purpose of this position is to provide local supervision to a team of managers responsible for examining installation assistance files and overseeing regional installation policy.  Currently, nearly 2,300 living files are managed by the installation assistance system center.  Local management Lead and plan the activity of the division: definition of objectives and priorities, adaptation of the team's activities with regard to workloads, in conjunction with its line manager; Monitor the overall activity of the division and monitor the individual activity of the agents of the division; Provide technical and economic expertise in installation assistance files to managers, resolution of complex files; Organize and coordinate the various processes of the division in order to ensure fluidity in the processing of files; Organize the monitoring and implementation of the supervision and control processes of managers’ files; Propose budgetary developments and monitoring (commitments, payments) linked to this policy in connection with the Regional and FEADER budgets; Ensure day-to-day HR management in conjunction with your department manager; Ensure the replacement of the department manager during absence.  Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory; Organize and lead strategic meetings (regional installation committee in Normandy, meeting of prescribers, etc.); Represent the Region in strategic and field meetings for technical intervention and promotion of regional mechanisms; Provide technical-economic expertise to external requests for installation assistance files, as well as the liveability and viability of the installation projects presented; Monitor the evolution of current programming and its regulatory developments by being proactive in developing, modernizing and simplifying aid systems and their processes; Monitor the evaluation of the devices and its control methods; Design and update internal procedural documents, external documents intended for beneficiaries and partner structures of the installation, writing notes and reports Profile Expected skills Experience and knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, particularly agricultural and equine, and in particularly the analysis of the resulting economic data;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy. Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. Local management Lead and plan the activity of the division: definition of objectives and priorities, adaptation of the team's activities with regard to workloads, in conjunction with its line manager; Monitor the overall activity of the division and monitor the individual activity of the agents of the division; Provide technical and economic expertise in installation assistance files to managers, resolution of complex files; Organize and coordinate the various processes of the division in order to ensure fluidity in the processing of files; Organize the monitoring and implementation of the supervision and control processes of managers’ files; Propose budgetary developments and monitoring (commitments, payments) linked to this policy in connection with the Regional and FEADER budgets; Ensure day-to-day HR management in conjunction with your department manager; Ensure the replacement of the department manager during absence.  Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory; Organize and lead strategic meetings (regional installation committee in Normandy, meeting of prescribers, etc.); Represent the Region in strategic and field meetings for technical intervention and promotion of regional mechanisms; Provide technical-economic expertise to external requests for installation assistance files, as well as the liveability and viability of the installation projects presented; Monitor the evolution of current programming and its regulatory developments by being proactive in developing, modernizing and simplifying aid systems and their processes; Monitor the evaluation of the devices and its control methods; Design and update internal procedural documents, external documents intended for beneficiaries and partner structures of the installation, writing notes and reports Profile Expected skills Experience and knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, particularly agricultural and equine, and in particularly the analysis of the resulting economic data;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy. Recruitment conditions Remuneration according to statutory conditions + Compensation scheme. Vacant position to be filled as soon as possible according to the statutory recruitment procedures. job_title: Växthusarbetare till food tech-bolag
job_description: Do you have a genuine interest in plants? Are you attracted by independent physical work in a lovely environment? Apply for a position as a greenhouse worker for one of Sweden's most exciting food tech companies. Your future challenge Agtira is an innovative food tech company that supplies and operates vegetable farms. Right now, the company is in a growth phase and will therefore start a new facility in Kramfors in early 2025. For this facility, we are now looking for greenhouse workers who want to be involved from the start to build up this exciting business. Within Agtira, we are a total of 31 people who are distributed across five different facilities in Sweden. We are a tightly knit team that works together to develop the urban farms of the future. We do this by offering our customers Farming as a Service. In the role of a greenhouse worker, you will be responsible for daily plant care, quality assurance and biological control. Tasks that occur are: Planting Weeding Pruning Harvesting cucumbers Packaging cucumbers Who you are We are looking for you as has a genuine interest in plants. You also need to have an eye for details and like independent and physical work. It is desirable that you have previous experience with growing plants as well as with greenhouse equipment and scissor lifts. Good knowledge of Swedish and English is a requirement. You are over 18 years old. About the companyAgtira is a food tech company that supplies and operates facilities for sustainable and profitable food production. By growing cucumbers, tomatoes, herbs and other vegetables directly adjacent to stores, we eliminate the transport route and ensure that consumers can eat fresh vegetables all year round. Our Farming-as-a-Service (FaaS) business model means that we build and operate a tailor-made facility for the products the customer wants. The customer buys his entire needs at fixed prices for a longer period, up to 15 years. Our facilities are currently located in Härnösand, Sundsvall, Östersund and Skellefteå, as well as a new facility in Haninge that will open this autumn. Our ambition is to be a world leader in cultivation in urban environments and constantly develop both cultivation methods and software support. Click on the link to find out more! Agtira - Here-grown vegetables every day, all year round (youtube.com) Contact person If you have questions about the position, contact: Lisa Fagerström, recruitment consultant Cre8 Future, lisa.fagerstrom@cre8future.se , 076-8241789 Warm welcome with your application! turns.content: What other occupations besides aircraft engine specialist require an understanding of these procedures?

Based on the information provided by the database, here are various occupations that involve inspection, testing, and quality assurance procedures, excluding those related to aircraft engines:

*   **Manufacturing and Assembly Inspectors:**
    *   **Motor vehicle assembly inspector:** Uses measuring and testing equipment to monitor motor vehicle assemblies for conformity to engineering, manufacturing, quality, and safety standards.
    *   **Vessel assembly inspector:** Inspects boat and ship assemblies to ensure conformity to engineering specifications and safety regulations.
    *   **Rolling stock assembly inspector:** Monitors rolling stock assemblies (locomotives/carriages) to ensure they meet engineering specifications and safety standards.
    *   **Aircraft assembly inspector:** Monitors aircraft assemblies to ensure conformity to engineering specifications and safety standards.
    *   **Product assembly inspector:** Evaluates products against client requirements and engineering specifications using testing equipment.
    *   **Motor vehicle assembler:** Installs parts and tests assembled equipment for performance and quality standards.

*   **Engine and Mechanical Testing:**
    *   **Motor vehicle engine tester:** Tests performance of various vehicle engines (diesel, petrol, gas, electric) using computerized equipment in laboratory settings.
    *   **Vessel engine tester:** Tests performance of marine engines (nuclear reactors, gas turbines, diesel, etc.) in specialized facilities.
    *   **Rolling stock engine tester:** Tests performance of locomotive diesel and electric engines.
    *   **Motor vehicle engine inspector:** Conducts routine, post-overhaul, and post-casualty inspections of vehicle engines.
    *   **Vessel engine inspector:** Inspects ship and boat engines to ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations.
    *   **Rolling stock engine inspector:** Inspects locomotive engines to ensure compliance with standards and regulations.

*   **Quality Engineering and Technical Roles:**
    *   **Quality engineer:** Defines quality standards for products or services and coordinates quality improvements.
    *   **Quality engineering technician:** Works to analyze and solve quality problems, inspects products to ensure standards are met, and prepares inspection plans.
    *   **Chemical manufacturing quality technician:** Performs inspections and precision measurements to ensure product quality.
    *   **Commissioning engineer/technician:** Supervises the final stages of projects to verify that installed systems meet requirements and specifications.
    *   **Calibration technician:** Tests and calibrates electrical and electronic equipment according to technical drawings.

*   **Inspection and Compliance Roles:**
    *   **Utilities inspector:** Examines systems like water, sewer, or gas turbines to ensure they function according to regulations.
    *   **Industrial waste inspector / Hazardous waste inspector:** Ensures companies comply with environmental and waste management regulations.
    *   **Weights and measures inspector:** Ensures compliance with regulations regarding the weight and measures of packaged goods.
    *   **Building inspector:** Assesses the suitability and quality of construction and compliance with regulations.
    *   **Marine surveyor:** Inspects vessels to ensure they follow International Maritime Organisation (IMO) regulations.
    *   **Fire safety tester:** Measures flame resistance and behavior of materials under extreme circumstances.
    *   **Consumer goods inspector:** Evaluates products for defects and compliance with client requirements.
    *   **Precision device inspector:** Ensures devices like micrometers and gauges operate according to design specifications.
    *   **Electrical/Electronic equipment inspector:** Checks finished electrical and electronic products for defects and regulation compliance.
    *   **Printed circuit board test technician:** Inspects and performs tests on printed circuit boards.
    *   **Automated optical inspection operator:** Operates machines to inspect finished or in-process PCB assemblies for flaws.
    *   **Computer hardware test technician:** Tests hardware reliability and conformance to specifications.
    *   **Control panel tester:** Tests electrical control panels for wiring accuracy and functionality.
    *   **Battery test technician:** Tests battery resistance and identifies flaws in rejected batteries.

**Upload Date:** December 5, 2024

The company is looking for an agricultural engineer/cultivation consultant to strengthen their team, specifically focusing on growing potatoes for the food industry. Key responsibilities include:
*   Supporting and advising contract farmers on plant cultivation, quality assurance, and certification.
*   Controlling harvest logistics for factory and warehouse supply, as well as warehouse management.
*   Coordinating and controlling seed potato logistics and external contract goods.
*   Carrying out harvest assessments and supervising internal testing.
*   Managing quality and sustainability.

*   A completed degree in the agricultural sector or a comparable qualification.
*   Ideally, initial experience in potato cultivation.
*   Ability to work in a team, strong communication skills, and a confident demeanor.
*   Proficiency in common MS Office applications.

**Benefits offered:**
*   Attractive and performance-oriented compensation.
*   Company car for private use.
*   30 days vacation.
*   Bicycle leasing and flexible working hours.
*   Additional benefits including holiday/Christmas bonuses, capital formation benefits, company pension schemes, and anniversary bonuses.
*   Individual training and development opportunities.

role_title: energy manager

role_title: business developer

role_title: client relations manager

They also have possible other tasks such as developing plans or delivering proposals.

role_title: strategic planning manager

role_title: renewable energy consultant

role_title: online community manager

role_title: information manager

role_title: environmental programme coordinator

role_title: regulatory affairs manager

role_title: corporate risk manager

They report on risk issues to the senior management and the company's board.

role_title: public relations officer

role_title: communication manager

j.description: Do you have a genuine interest in plants? Are you attracted by independent physical work in a lovely environment? Apply for a position as a greenhouse worker for one of Sweden's most exciting food tech companies. Your future challenge Agtira is an innovative food tech company that supplies and operates vegetable farms. Right now, the company is in a growth phase and will therefore start a new facility in Kramfors in early 2025. For this facility, we are now looking for greenhouse workers who want to be involved from the start to build up this exciting business. Within Agtira, we are a total of 31 people who are distributed across five different facilities in Sweden. We are a tightly knit team that works together to develop the urban farms of the future. We do this by offering our customers Farming as a Service. In the role of a greenhouse worker, you will be responsible for daily plant care, quality assurance and biological control. Tasks that occur are: Planting Weeding Pruning Harvesting cucumbers Packaging cucumbers Who you are We are looking for you as has a genuine interest in plants. You are over 18 years old. About the companyAgtira is a food tech company that supplies and operates facilities for sustainable and profitable food production. By growing cucumbers, tomatoes, herbs and other vegetables directly adjacent to stores, we eliminate the transport route and ensure that consumers can eat fresh vegetables all year round. Our Farming-as-a-Service (FaaS) business model means that we build and operate a tailor-made facility for the products the customer wants. The customer buys his entire needs at fixed prices for a longer period, up to 15 years. Our facilities are currently located in Härnösand, Sundsvall, Östersund and Skellefteå, as well as a new facility in Haninge that will open this autumn. Our ambition is to be a world leader in cultivation in urban environments and constantly develop both cultivation methods and software support. Click on the link to find out more! Agtira - Here-grown vegetables every day, all year round (youtube.com) Contact person If you have questions about the position, contact: Lisa Fagerström, recruitment consultant Cre8 Future, lisa.fagerstrom@cre8future.se , 076-8241789 Warm welcome with your application! Selection takes place on an ongoing basis, so submit your application as soon as possible. Last date for applications 6 January. Places Kramfors

*   An eye for detail and a preference for independent, physical work.
*   Good knowledge of Swedish and English.
*   Must be over 18 years old.
*   Previous experience with growing plants and greenhouse equipment is desirable (and specifically experience with scissor lifts for the Kramfors roles). 
*   The employer is Agtira, a food tech company focusing on urban farming and "Farming as a Service."

Our facilities are currently located in Härnösand, Sundsvall, Östersund and Skellefteå, as well as a new facility in Haninge that will open this autumn. Our ambition is to be a world leader in cultivation in urban environments and constantly develop both cultivation methods and software support. Click on the link to find out more! The position involves independent work in a breeding station, with tasks ranging from sowing preparation and inventory management to pollination, leaf sampling, harvesting, and crop processing. You would also be responsible for coordinating breeding programs and managing breeding data.

*   **Qualifications:** Completed training as an LTA (Agricultural Technical Assistant), ATA, PT, or a comparable qualification.

*   **Personal Attributes:** High level of commitment, reliability, team-oriented, good self-management, and strong communication skills.
*   **Availability:** Willingness to work extra hours, including weekends and public holidays.

### Benefits
*   Permanent employment contract with an attractive salary package (including holiday/Christmas bonuses, profit sharing, and 30 days of annual leave).
*   Additional perks: Employee discounts, job bike, capital formation benefits, company pension scheme, and the opportunity to purchase KWS shares at a preferential price.
*   Professional work clothing and a friendly, respectful working atmosphere.

occupation_label: ICT environmental manager
description: ICT environmental managers know the green ICT legal framework, understand the role of the ICT network configurations in the economy and energy resources deployment and evaluate the impact of CO2 footprint of each ICT resource in the organisation's network. occupation_label: ICT help desk agent

occupation_label: ICT help desk manager

occupation_label: ICT integration tester
